news.titleTr: Thousands of jobs at Virgin Media O2 to be cut
news.summaryTr: The broadband provider has not finalised the number of roles to be axed but it will likely be a sizeable chunk of its workforce, the BBC understands.
news.articleText: Thousands of jobs at Virgin Media O2 to be cut - Published Thousands of Virgin Media O2 staff face redundancy risk as the telecoms firm looks to save money in the face of billions of pounds of debt and tougher competition. The broadband provider has not finalised the number of roles to be cut but it is likely be a sizeable chunk of its 16,000 workforce, the BBC understands. VMO2 has billions of debt on its balance sheet and is tackling competition from both smaller providers as well as giants like BT, which has agreed a deal to acquire rival TalkTalk, a move which VMO2 has firmly opposed. VMO2 declined to comment. The Prospect union, which represents VMO2 staff, said the cuts were "disappointing and very unsettling". Deputy general secretary Noel McClean said it is "committed to supporting our members through what is a difficult time, as well as also working with employers to explore ways to mitigate the number of redundancies and ensure retraining and redeployment of staff affected". The majority of the affected staff will be in non-customer facing roles and a number of senior leadership changes are already under way, the BBC has been told. VMO2 is also expected to review its use of contractors and suppliers in conjunction with the job cuts that were first reported by Sky News. As of 30 June, VMO2's total debt stands at £27.2bn while it holds assets worth £45.9bn, according to the firm's latest accounts. Meanwhile, the company is dealing with fierce competition from cheaper "altnets" like Hyperoptic, Community Fibre, Gigaclear, and YouFibre. VMO2's had attempted to respond to this growing threat by buying altnet competitor Netomnia for £2bn via nexfibre, a joint venture owned by VMO2's owners. However, the Competition Markets Authority (CMA) has provisionally found competition concerns in the deal, external, with a final decision to come in December, sparking anger from VMO2. BT share price jump At the time, VMO2 called the BT takeover a "stitch-up", which allowed its rival "tighten its grip" over the market. BT said its deal provided "a safety net" for TalkTalk customers as their broadband provider faced collapse without the takeover. On Friday, BT's share price jumped 7% after the Financial Times reported VMO2 was close to agreeing a deal , external to use its rival's fibre broadband network. VMO2 was minded to go ahead with the plans after halting upgrades and expansion of its own infrastructure to ease concerns over its debt pile, the paper reported. The BBC has been told the deal is very close and that VMO2 is highly likely to announce it will stop all investment in fibre in its results on Tuesday. Additional reporting by Ben King - Published5 October

news.summary: Galatasaray'da 27 Ekim'deki yönetim kurulu toplantısında yaşanan tartışmanın ardından iki yönetici istifa etti. Sportif AŞ Başkan Vekili Abdullah Kavukcu ile İkinci Başkan Metin Öztürk, yönetim kurulu ve bağlı şirketlerdeki görevlerinden ayrıldıklarını açıkladı.

news.titleTr: Galatasaray yönetiminde peş peşe istifa: İki isim görevini bıraktı
news.summaryTr: Galatasaray'da 27 Ekim'deki yönetim kurulu toplantısında yaşanan tartışmanın ardından iki yönetici istifa etti. Sportif AŞ Başkan Vekili Abdullah Kavukcu ile İkinci Başkan Metin Öztürk, yönetim kurulu ve bağlı şirketlerdeki görevlerinden ayrıldıklarını açıkladı.
news.articleText: Galatasaray yönetiminde peş peşe istifa: İki isim görevini bıraktı - Galatasaray'da 27 Ekim'deki yönetim kurulu toplantısında yaşanan tartışmanın ardından iki yönetici istifa etti. - Sportif AŞ Başkan Vekili Abdullah Kavukcu ile İkinci Başkan Metin Öztürk, yönetim kurulu ve bağlı şirketlerdeki görevlerinden ayrıldıklarını açıkladı. Galatasaray Kulübü yönetiminde yaşanan tartışma istifaları beraberinde getirdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Yönetim Kurulu Üyesi ve Sportif AŞ Başkan Vekili Abdullah Kavukcu ile Kulüp İkinci Başkanı Metin Öztürk, görevlerinden ayrıldıklarını duyurdu. Abdullah Kavukcu, sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı açıklamada, 27 Ekim'deki yönetim kurulu toplantısının ardından Metin Öztürk ile arasında yaşanan sözlü tartışmanın özellikle sosyal medyada gerçek boyutlarından uzaklaştırıldığını belirtti. Tartışmanın kulübün hedeflerinin ve birlik beraberliğinin önüne geçmesini istemediğini ifade eden Kavukcu, Galatasaray'ın itibarının zarar görmemesi için yönetim kurulu üyeliğinden istifa etme kararı aldığını bildirdi. Kavukcu, Galatasaray'a bağlılığının herhangi bir görev veya unvanla sınırlı olmadığını vurgulayarak, kulübün başarısı için katkı sunmaya devam edeceğini kaydetti. Metin Öztürk de istifa etti Galatasaray Kulübü İkinci Başkanı Metin Öztürk de sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı açıklamayla yönetim kurulu ve kulübe bağlı şirketlerdeki görevlerinden istifa ettiğini duyurdu. 27 Ekim'deki yönetim kurulu toplantısında yaşananlara ilişkin açıklama yapan Öztürk, tartışmanın fiili saldırıya ve hayatını kaybeden annesine yönelik hakarete dönüştüğünü öne sürdü. Öztürk, bu durumu kabul edemeyeceğini belirterek Galatasaray Yönetim Kurulu ve bağlı şirketlerdeki yönetim kurulu üyeliklerinden ayrıldığını açıkladı.

news.title: 15 yaş altına sosyal medya yasağı yürürlüğe girdi: Yaş doğrulamada e-Devlet şartı
news.summary: Çocukların sosyal medya kullanımına yaş sınırı getiren yönetmelik Resmi Gazete'de yayımlanarak yürürlüğe girdi. 15 yaşını doldurmamış çocuklara sosyal medya hizmeti sunulamayacak, mevcut hesaplar için yaş doğrulaması 31 Mart 2027'ye kadar tamamlanacak.

news.titleTr: 15 yaş altına sosyal medya yasağı yürürlüğe girdi: Yaş doğrulamada e-Devlet şartı
news.summaryTr: Çocukların sosyal medya kullanımına yaş sınırı getiren yönetmelik Resmi Gazete'de yayımlanarak yürürlüğe girdi. 15 yaşını doldurmamış çocuklara sosyal medya hizmeti sunulamayacak, mevcut hesaplar için yaş doğrulaması 31 Mart 2027'ye kadar tamamlanacak.
news.articleText: 15 yaş altına sosyal medya yasağı yürürlüğe girdi: Yaş doğrulamada e-Devlet şartı Çocukların sosyal medya kullanımına yaş sınırı getiren yönetmelik Resmi Gazete'de yayımlanarak yürürlüğe girdi. 15 yaşını doldurmamış çocuklara sosyal medya hizmeti sunulamayacak, mevcut hesaplar için yaş doğrulaması 31 Mart 2027'ye kadar tamamlanacak. Aile ve Sosyal Hizmetler Bakanı Mahinur Özdemir Göktaş, çocukların sosyal medya kullanımına yönelik yeni yaş sınırlaması yönetmeliğinin yürürlüğe girdiğini duyurdu. Düzenlemeyle 15 yaşını doldurmamış çocukların sosyal medya platformlarında hesap açmasının önüne geçilirken, 15-18 yaş grubuna özel hizmet sunulması zorunlu hale geldi. Bakan Göktaş, NSosyal hesabından yaptığı açıklamada, yeni düzenlemenin çocukların dijital ortamda korunması açısından önemli bir adım olduğunu belirtti. Yönetmelik kapsamında sosyal medya platformları, 15 yaşını doldurmamış çocuklara hizmet sunamayacak. 15-18 yaş aralığındaki kullanıcılar için ise yaş grubuna özel, ayrıştırılmış hizmetler sağlanacak. Platformlar ayrıca kullanışlı ebeveyn kontrol araçları sunacak. Yaş doğrulamada e-Devlet zorunlu olacak Yeni açılacak sosyal medya hesaplarında yaş doğrulaması zorunlu tutulacak. Mevcut hesapların da 31 Mart 2027'ye kadar yaş doğrulama işlemini tamamlaması gerekecek. Bakan Göktaş, yaş doğrulama işlemlerinin yalnızca turkiye.gov.tr adresi ve resmi e-Devlet uygulaması üzerinden yapılabileceğini bildirdi. Bunun dışındaki internet siteleri ve uygulamalar üzerinden doğrulama yapılamayacak. Çocukların sosyal medya hesaplarına hangi kısıtlamalar gelecek? Bakanlığın paylaştığı bilgilere göre yeni düzenleme kapsamında çocuklara yönelik sosyal medya hizmetlerinde çeşitli özellikler sınırlandırılacak. Bu kapsamda: Çocuklara yalnızca takip ettikleri hesaplardan mesaj gönderilebilecek. Mesajlarda görüldü bilgisi gösterilmeyecek. Canlı yayın açılması engellenecek. Ekran görüntüsü alınamayacak. Hesap önerileri yapılamayacak. Kişiselleştirme ve kişiye özel reklam uygulanmayacak. Rehber eşleştirmesi yapılamayacak. Ebeveynlere hangi kontrol imkanları sunulacak? Yeni düzenlemeyle ebeveynlerin çocuklarının sosyal medya kullanımını takip etmesi ve sınırlandırması da hedefleniyor. Ebeveynler hesap ve özellik ayarlarını yönetebilecek; uygulama içi satın alma, kiralama ve ücretli üyelik işlemlerini kontrol edebilecek. Ayrıca harcama limitleri ve kullanım süreleri belirlenebilecek, konum paylaşımı mekanizmaları üzerinde kontrol sağlanabilecek. Sosyal medya platformlarına da yükümlülük getiriliyor Yeni yönetmelik yalnızca kullanıcılara yaş sınırı getirmekle kalmıyor, sosyal ağ sağlayıcılarına da çocukların korunmasına yönelik teknik ve idari sorumluluklar yüklüyor. Yaş doğrulama, ebeveyn kontrol araçları ve çocuklara özel hizmetlerin uygulanması platformların yerine getirmesi gereken yükümlülükler arasında yer alıyor.

news.titleTr: Atila Türeli kimdir, kaç yaşında, nereli? Atila Türeli'nin hayatı ve kariyeri
news.summaryTr: Borsa İstanbul Genel Müdür Yardımcısı Atila Türeli, Yönetim Kurulu kararıyla genel müdürlük görevine vekaleten atandı. Türeli, kurumda 2000 yılından bu yana farklı kademelerde görev yapıyor.
news.articleText: Atila Türeli kimdir, kaç yaşında, nereli? Atila Türeli'nin hayatı ve kariyeri - 1970 yılında Konya'da doğan Atila Türeli Borsa İstanbul A.Ş. Genel Müdürlüğü görevine vekaleten getirildi. Türeli, kurumda 2000 yılından bu yana farklı kademelerde görev yaptı. Peki, Atila Türeli kimdir, kaç yaşında, nereli? İşte eğitimi, mesleki kariyeri ve hayatına ilişkin merak edilenler. Borsa İstanbul'da üst düzey yönetim değişikliği yaşandı. Borsa İstanbul A.Ş. Genel Müdür Yardımcısı Atila Türeli, Yönetim Kurulu kararıyla Genel Müdürlük görevine vekaleten getirildi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Peki, Atila Türeli kimdir, kaç yaşında, nereli ve hangi okullardan mezun oldu? İşte Atila Türeli'nin biyografisi... Atila Türeli kimdir? Atila Türeli 1970'de Konya Ereğli'de doğdu. İlkokulu Ereğli Cumhuriyet İlkokulu'nda, ortaokul ve liseyi Konya Anadolu Lisesi'nde tamamlayan Türeli, 1993'te İstanbul Üniversitesi Hukuk Fakültesi'nden mezun oldu. Bahçeşehir Üniversitesi Sosyal Bilimler Enstitüsünde Avrupa Birliği Kamu Hukuku ve Entegrasyon yüksek lisans programını 2008'de tamamladı. Avukatlık ruhsatını 1994'te alan Türeli, 2000 yılına kadar adli yargıda hakim olarak görev yaptı. Türeli, 2000 yılında İstanbul Menkul Kıymetler Borsası'nın (İMKB) açtığı sınavı kazanarak Hukuk Müşavirliğinde avukat olarak göreve başladı. Aynı bölümde 2000-2012 yılları arasında her kademede çalışan Türeli, 2012-2014'te üye işleri bölüm müdürü, 2014-2016'da uyum bölüm müdürü, 2016-2023 arasında ise başhukuk müşaviri olarak görev yaptı. Halen Türkiye Ürün İhtisas Borsası (TÜRİB) Yönetim Kurulu Üyesi ve İstanbul Tahkim Merkezi Genel Kurul Üyesi olan Türeli'nin çeşitli hukuk dallarında uzman arabuluculuk sertifikaları bulunuyor.

news.summary: İran Dışişleri Bakanı Abbas Erakçi, Hürmüz Boğazı'na ilişkin iki günlük plan konusunda Katarlı arabulucularla yürütülen görüşmelerde henüz kesin bir sonuca ulaşılmadığını açıkladı. Erakçi, Tahran'ın hem diplomasiye hem de olası senaryolara hazır olduğunu söyledi.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Hürmüz Boğazı için kritik temas: İran'dan yeni açıklama
news.summaryTr: İran Dışişleri Bakanı Abbas Erakçi, Hürmüz Boğazı'na ilişkin iki günlük plan konusunda Katarlı arabulucularla yürütülen görüşmelerde henüz kesin bir sonuca ulaşılmadığını açıkladı. Erakçi, Tahran'ın hem diplomasiye hem de olası senaryolara hazır olduğunu söyledi.
news.articleText: Hürmüz Boğazı için kritik temas: İran'dan yeni açıklama - İran Dışişleri Bakanı Abbas Erakçi, Hürmüz Boğazı'na ilişkin iki günlük plan konusunda Katarlı arabulucularla yürütülen görüşmelerde henüz kesin bir sonuca ulaşılmadığını açıkladı. - Erakçi, Tahran'ın hem diplomasiye hem de olası senaryolara hazır olduğunu söyledi. İran ile ABD arasındaki gerilimin gölgesinde Hürmüz Boğazı'na ilişkin diplomatik temaslar sürüyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İran Dışişleri Bakanı Abbas Erakçi, Katar aracılığıyla yürütülen görüşmelerde henüz uzlaşmaya varılamadığını belirtti. İran resmi haber ajansı IRNA'ya göre Erakçi, Meclis Ulusal Güvenlik ve Dış Politika Komisyonu toplantısının ardından yaptığı açıklamada, İran heyetinin Katar ziyaretini değerlendirdi. Görüşmelerin devam ettiğini belirten Erakçi, kesin bir sonuca ulaşılmasının karşı tarafın İran'ın sorularına vereceği yanıtlara bağlı olduğunu söyledi. Ziyaretin Dışişleri Bakan Yardımcısı düzeyinde gerçekleştirildiğini aktaran Erakçi, temasların son haftalarda Tahran'da bulunan Katarlı arabulucularla istişareleri sürdürmek amacı taşıdığını kaydetti. ABD ile doğrudan müzakere planı yok Erakçi, Katar ziyaretinde ABD tarafıyla doğrudan müzakere yapılmasının planlanmadığını vurguladı. Hürmüz Boğazı'na ilişkin iki günlük plan üzerindeki görüşmelerin arabulucular aracılığıyla devam ettiğini ifade etti. Diplomatik çabaları sürdürdüklerini belirten Erakçi, karşı tarafın da diplomasiye öncelik vermesini beklediklerini dile getirdi. "İran tüm senaryolara hazır" İran'ın olası tüm senaryolara hazırlıklı olduğunu söyleyen Erakçi, ülke lideri Mücteba Hamaney'in üst düzey askeri komutanlara verdiği talimatların İran'ın kararlılığını ortaya koyduğunu savundu. İran Silahlı Kuvvetlerinin görevlerinin net olduğunu belirten Erakçi, önceki iki savaştan edinilen tecrübeler sayesinde ordunun eskisinden daha güçlü olduğunu ileri sürdü. Erakçi, İran'ın savunma ve diplomasi süreçlerini eş zamanlı yürütmeye hazır olduğunu, ABD'nin hangi yolu seçeceğinin ise kendi yaklaşımına bağlı bulunduğunu söyledi. Hürmüz Boğazı neden önemli? Hürmüz Boğazı, Basra Körfezi'ni Umman Körfezi ve Arap Denizi'ne bağlayan, küresel enerji ticaretinin en kritik geçiş noktalarından biri olarak kabul ediliyor. Dünya petrol tüketiminin yaklaşık beşte birine karşılık gelen petrol ve petrol ürünleri bu güzergâhtan taşınıyor. Boğazdaki olası bir aksama, petrol fiyatları ve küresel enerji arzı üzerinde doğrudan etkili olabiliyor.

news.summaryTr: ABD'de 3 Kasım'da yapılacak Kongre ara seçimleri öncesinde anketler, hem Temsilciler Meclisi hem de Senatoda Demokratların avantajlı olduğunu gösteriyor. Ancak başa baş yarışın sürdüğü eyalet ve seçim bölgeleri, Kongre'deki çoğunluğun hangi partide olacağını belirleyebilir.
news.articleText: ABD ara seçimlerinde kritik eşik: Senato ve Temsilciler Meclisi için yarış kızıştı - ABD'de 3 Kasım'da yapılacak Kongre ara seçimleri öncesinde anketler, hem Temsilciler Meclisi hem de Senatoda Demokratların avantajlı olduğunu gösteriyor. Ancak başa baş yarışın sürdüğü eyalet ve seçim bölgeleri, Kongre'deki çoğunluğun hangi partide olacağını belirleyebilir. ABD'de Kongre ara seçimleri yaklaşırken siyasi dengelerin değişebileceğine yönelik beklentiler güçleniyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle 3 Kasım'da gerçekleştirilecek seçimlerde 435 sandalyeli Temsilciler Meclisi'nin tamamı ve 100 sandalyeli Senatonun 35 sandalyesi için seçmenler sandık başına gidecek. Ülke genelinde yapılan anketlerin ortalaması, Demokratların her iki kanatta da Cumhuriyetçilere karşı avantaj yakaladığını ortaya koyuyor. Ancak özellikle başa baş yarışın sürdüğü seçim bölgelerinde sonuçların son ana kadar değişebileceği değerlendiriliyor. Senatoda Demokratlar önde Real Clear Politics (RCP) tarafından derlenen anket ortalamalarına göre, Senatoda Demokratların 47, Cumhuriyetçilerin ise 45 sandalye kazanması bekleniyor. Sekiz eyaletteki yarışta ise adaylar arasındaki rekabet sürüyor. Başa baş yarışın yaşandığı sekiz sandalyenin yedisinde Cumhuriyetçiler, birinde ise Demokratlar önde görünüyor. Cumhuriyetçilerin bu sekiz sandalyeden en az beşini kazanması halinde Senatoda 50 sandalyeye ulaşması bekleniyor. Bu durumda oluşabilecek 50-50 eşitlikte Başkan Yardımcısı JD Vance'in eşitlik bozma oyu Cumhuriyetçilere çoğunluğu sağlayabilir. ABD yasalarına göre Senato Başkanı görevini de yürüten başkan yardımcısı, oyların eşit çıkması halinde belirleyici oy kullanabiliyor. Temsilciler Meclisi'nde de Demokratlar avantajlı 435 sandalyenin tamamının yenileneceği Temsilciler Meclisi'nde çoğunluğu elde etmek için 218 sandalyeye ulaşmak gerekiyor. RCP'nin anket ortalamalarına göre Demokratların 227, Cumhuriyetçilerin ise 182 sandalye kazanması öngörülüyor. Bununla birlikte 26 sandalye için iki parti arasındaki yarışın başa baş devam ettiği belirtiliyor. Mevcut tahminler, Demokratların Temsilciler Meclisi'nde çoğunluğu yeniden kazanma ihtimalinin daha yüksek olduğuna işaret ediyor. Kongre'de mevcut sandalye dağılımı ABD Kongresinin mevcut yapısında Senatoda Cumhuriyetçilerin 53, Demokratların 45 sandalyesi bulunuyor. İki bağımsız senatör ise birçok konuda Demokratlarla birlikte hareket ediyor. Temsilciler Meclisinde Cumhuriyetçilerin 218, Demokratların 214 sandalyesi bulunurken bir sandalye bağımsız üyeye ait. İki sandalye ise boş durumda. Ara seçimler neden önemli? ABD'de ara seçimler, başkanlık seçimlerinin yapıldığı dönemlerin ortasında, dört yıllık başkanlık süresinin ikinci yılında düzenleniyor. Seçimler, başkanın görev süresinin kalan bölümünde Kongre üzerindeki siyasi kontrolünü doğrudan etkiliyor. Kongre'nin iki kanadında çoğunluğu kaybeden başkanın yasa çıkarma ve ekonomi politikalarını hayata geçirme süreci zorlaşabiliyor.

news.titleTr: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summaryTr: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
news.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto: The FBI said that North Korea was responsible for the theft of about $6.3 billion in digital assets from cryptocurrency exchange Binance. Soon after the $6.3 billion hack of Binance, some political and administration figures began offering their opinions with a US election approaching on Nov. 3 and voting already having begun in many locations. Coinbase led a selloff in crypto-linked stocks following Binance’s record-breaking $6.3 billion hack. FBI blames North Korea for record $6.3B Binance hack The FBI said that the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (North Korea) was responsible for the theft of about $6.3 billion in digital assets from cryptocurrency exchange Binance on Thursday. The FBI said on Saturday in a news release that it refers to this specific North Korean malicious cyber activity as “TraderTraitor,” which it has most recently observed converting stolen assets mostly into Ether (ETH). It expects these assets to be further converted, using DeFi and instant swap services, as the hackers move to more advanced laundering stages. The FBI urged private sector entities including THORNode operators, RPC node operators, instant exchanges, DeFi services, blockchain analytics firms and other digital asset service providers to block transactions with or derived from addresses TraderTraitor actors are using to launder these stolen assets. A full list of addresses is provided on the news release. Binance hack sparks pre-election political clashes Soon after the $6.3 billion hack of Binance, the biggest in crypto history, some political and administration figures began offering their opinions with a US election approaching on Nov. 3 and voting already having begun in many locations. President Donald Trump was asked at a news conference on Friday about the hack of Binance. “We don’t know. We’re looking at that, the hack with Binance. They’re saying they’re going to get it back, they’re saying they’re guaranteeing it,” he replied. The crypto exchange said in a post on X late Friday that it would cover any losses. “We want to be clear about our commitment: Binance will absorb the financial impact of these stolen funds, not our users.” It added that about $3 billion of the stolen funds had already been frozen in various locations. On Saturday, Binance said it had already covered 90% of the impacted amount of the hacked loss. It was not clear whether there was any immediate political advantage to be gained from the hack, which was widely attributed to a North Korean group, but Republican and Democratic sides began staking out positions almost immediately. Coinbase leads crypto stock selloff following $6.3 billion Binance hack Shares of publicly traded cryptocurrency companies fell sharply Friday, with Coinbase dropping more than 13% a day after reporting a decline in third-quarter revenue, as the industry dealt with Binance’s $6.3 billion hack. Other crypto-linked stocks also declined, with stablecoin issuer Circle Internet Group (CRCL) falling more than 9% and Bitcoin treasury company Strategy (MSTR) dropping about 8%, according to Yahoo Finance data at the time of writing. The selloff also hit Bitcoin mining and data center operator IREN (IREN), whose shares fell more than 10%, and blockchain-based financial services company Figure Technology Solutions (FIGR), which dropped about 9%. The declines followed Thursday’s disclosure of the Binance breach. The exchange confirmed Friday that hackers stole about $6.3 billion in the largest cryptocurrency theft on record.

news.summary: The proposal comes amid intense competition among AI developers, including US companies Anthropic and OpenAI, the SCMP said.

news.titleTr: DeepSeek developing AI agent requiring less human input: Report
news.summaryTr: The proposal comes amid intense competition among AI developers, including US companies Anthropic and OpenAI, the SCMP said.
news.articleText: DeepSeek developing AI agent requiring less human input: Report The proposal comes amid intense competition among AI developers, including US companies Anthropic and OpenAI, the SCMP said. Chinese artificial intelligence company DeepSeek has revealed a design to increase the autonomy of AI coding assistants so they can perform multiple tasks with less human intervention. The aim is to reduce human input in coordinating and monitoring multiple AI agents, according to a paper published by the company’s DeepSeek Harness team and reported by Singapore’s South China Morning Post on Sunday. Managing multiple agents demands human attention, the team said, noting that “single-task limits depend on model capabilities, while multitask limits depend on human attention.” The DeepSeek paper said a person can oversee only three to five active AI agent sessions simultaneously. Its proposed system would distribute tasks among agents and coordinate their work, leaving humans free to review results and make decisions. The proposal comes amid intense competition among AI developers, including US companies Anthropic and OpenAI, according to the SCMP. Cointelegraph reported last October that Chinese artificial intelligence models were outperforming US counterparts in cryptocurrency trading, according to data from blockchain analytics platform CoinGlass. AI chatbot DeepSeek led a crypto trading experiment, being the only AI model to generate a positive unrealized return of 9.1%. The results surprised crypto traders, given that DeepSeek was developed at a fraction of the cost of its US rivals. Magazine: New DeepSeek ban in US, Swiss-Asia crypto ties deepen: Asia Express

news.title: Crypto firm Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3bn hack
news.summary: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) says North Korea was responsible for the hack.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Crypto firm Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3bn hack
news.summaryTr: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) says North Korea was responsible for the hack.
news.articleText: Crypto firm Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3bn hack - Published Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, says it has covered 90% of the $6.3bn (£4.7bn) assets stolen in a hack on Thursday. The remaining 10% may take longer to source in the required amounts, the company added. Binance has consistently pledged to cover 100% of the losses from what is suspected to be crypto's biggest hack on record and said it has set aside more than $6.34bn in company funds to do so. "Binance will absorb the financial impact of these stolen funds, not our users," the company said in a statement on Saturday. In an update on Sunday, Binance said withdrawals had been restored on several of its networks, after they were suspended following the hack. It previously said withdrawals would be resumed in phases. The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) said on Saturday that North Korea was responsible for the attack. The FBI said it had observed hackers converting stolen assets into a type of cryptocurrency called Ethereum and that it is expected that the assets will then be converted again using decentralised finance and instant swap services. Two analytics firms previously told the BBC they had robust intelligence pointing to North Korean state-backed hacking unit the Lazarus Group, also known as TraderTraitor - which was specifically named by the FBI - as the likely culprits. Speaking to reporters on Saturday night, US President Donald Trump said, external the US is still unsure who the culprits are. "We're learning about it. We don't know if it's North Korea - but if it is, we'll talk to North Korea about it," he said. Binance said it had replenished the stolen assets using various funds and its own corporate treasury. All holdings of the cryptocurrencies bitcoin, Ethereum and Tether are covered, along with seven other widely-traded crypto assets, the company said. The hack is believed to be the largest in history, eclipsing the record of a $1.5bn heist on the Bybit exchange in 2025 - for which the FBI also said North Korea was responsible. North Korea has always denied involvement in these attacks. Binance's initial investigation suggested an engineer's laptop was compromised, which allowed access to unauthorised withdrawals, but a later update said they had uncovered "additional points of breach". Richard Teng, Binance's co-chief executive officer, said the hack was carried out by more than one person, and the hackers used sophisticated methods to hide their tracks, such as a "self-destruct mechanism". On Friday, the company said it had frozen around $3bn of stolen assets after working with law enforcement, intelligence firms and partners. The investigation is ongoing, it added. The US Secret Service said on Friday it is "working around the clock" with private sector partners "to identify, freeze, trace, and recover funds" stolen from Binance. Binance, founded in China in 2017, lets users buy, sell and trade digital assets - it is estimated to have hundreds of millions of users worldwide. Crypto is a digital asset, which doesn't exist physically and is instead accessed via digital wallets or computers. Related topics - Published2 days ago

news.titleTr: Shops looted as German cost-of-living protests turn violent
news.summaryTr: The protests in cities across Germany - including Berlin, Hamburg and Frankfurt - came on the same day hundreds of thousands also protested in France.
news.articleText: Shops looted as German cost-of-living protests turn violent - Published Rioters looted shops in central Frankfurt late on Saturday as clashes erupted in German cities over the cost of living. Besides Frankfurt - Germany's financial hub - there were incidents of violence in Berlin, Cologne and Hamburg, with police saying they used water cannon to disperse protesters who were targeting emergency workers with fireworks, stones and bottles. Thousands joined largely peaceful demonstrations earlier in the day. They were organised by the campaign group Gen Z regelt - meaning "Gen Z takes charge" - to protest against underfunding in schools, the high cost of living, public spending cuts and military service. The unrest in Germany follows similar youth-led mass protests in France, where more than 320,000 people also demonstrated on Saturday. On Sunday, Germany's Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt told Bild newspaper that overnight police had prevented "violence like that seen in Paris" in recent weeks and called for "harsh punishments" for rioters and looters. Overnight, a large section of Frankfurt's main shopping street was closed off by police. A police spokesperson said many arrests were made in the city. Authorities in Frankfurt, Munich and Berlin reported as many as 18,000 protesters, roughly half of what the organisers had estimated on their website. news.summary: The crypto exchange said it has begun phased withdrawals after the record hack the FBI has blamed on North Korea.

news.titleTr: Binance says phase one of withdrawals opens after $6.3B hack
news.summaryTr: The crypto exchange said it has begun phased withdrawals after the record hack the FBI has blamed on North Korea.
news.articleText: Binance says phase one of withdrawals opens after $6.3B hack The crypto exchange said it has begun phased withdrawals after the record hack the FBI has blamed on North Korea. Binance said it has reopened its Bitcoin network in phase one of resuming withdrawals after a major hack of about $6.3 billion in funds. The crypto exchange had suspended user withdrawals after the attack on Thursday, which the FBI blamed on North Korean operatives. “First batch network now opened in phase one of withdrawals is $BTC bitcoin network,” Binance said on X. In an earlier X announcement on Sunday, Binance had said it would roll out withdrawal services in phases, which will be progressively available. Updates will be available on its official X channel, it added. “We are taking a phased approach by prioritizing tokens based on the past week data of user demand, so that each network and asset pair can be restored carefully, with stability and security checks completed before access is reopened,” Binance said. Users should check the withdrawal page for their selected asset and network, or visit the Binance network status page to confirm availability, the company said. During the phased rollout, it is expected that there will be some congestion, longer processing times and even temporary delays, Binance said, so if a withdrawal is not successful, users should try again after a short while. Cointelegraph reported on Saturday that Binance said it had replenished 90% of the assets stolen in the hack, up from 80% a day earlier, and remained on track to resume withdrawals Sunday. Magazine: Binance hackers raced to move billions before it could be frozen

news.title: FBI blames North Korea for record $6.3B Binance hack
news.summary: US agency seeks private-sector help to block further money-laundering of stolen digital assets.

news.titleTr: FBI blames North Korea for record $6.3B Binance hack
news.summaryTr: US agency seeks private-sector help to block further money-laundering of stolen digital assets.
news.articleText: FBI blames North Korea for record $6.3B Binance hack US agency seeks private-sector help to block further money-laundering of stolen digital assets. The FBI said that the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (North Korea) was responsible for the theft of about $6.3 billion in digital assets from cryptocurrency exchange Binance on Thursday. The FBI said on Saturday in a news release that it refers to this specific North Korean malicious cyber activity as “TraderTraitor,” which it has most recently observed converting stolen assets mostly into Ether (ETH). It expects these assets to be further converted, using DeFi and instant swap services, as the hackers move to more advanced laundering stages. The FBI urged private sector entities including THORNode operators, RPC node operators, instant exchanges, DeFi services, blockchain analytics firms and other digital asset service providers to block transactions with or derived from addresses TraderTraitor actors are using to launder these stolen assets. A full list of addresses is provided on the news release. Cointelegraph reported earlier this year that North Korea-linked hackers stole about 60% of the value lost to crypto hacks in 2025, with proceeds used to help fund the regime’s nuclear and ballistic missile programs, highlighting a growing reliance on digital assets to generate hard currency. North Korean defense spending supplemented Related: Crypto losses from North Korea hackers in 2025 rose 51% YoY: Report Those findings came from a CertiK report that attributed more than $2 billion of an estimated $3.4 billion in 2025 crypto security losses to groups tied North Korea, across 79 of 656 incidents documented that year. While North Korea does not publish credible budget data, according to independent research organization MilitarySpend, mid-range consensus places its actual annual defense spending at as much as $6 billion, using purchasing-power-adjusted GDP estimates, though this figure is uncertain. MilitarySpend adds that revenue from Russia arms transfers — estimated at as much as $5 billion in munitions exported to Russia from 2022-2025 per South Korean intelligence — supplements domestic weapons programs, as does cryptocurrency theft, which provides additional off-budget financing for WMD development. As Cointelegraph reported, between 2016 and early 2026, North Korea-linked actors stole an estimated $6.75 billion in cryptocurrency across 263 documented incidents, according to CertiK, citing findings by independent onchain researcher Taylor Monahan. CertiK’s analysis concluded that North Korea has industrialized crypto theft into a core state revenue mechanism. Magazine: Binance hackers raced to move billions before it could be frozen

news.title: Energy bills help 'doesn't go far enough'
news.summary: Families in the West Midlands say they are worried about paying winter energy bills.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Energy bills help 'doesn't go far enough'
news.summaryTr: Families in the West Midlands say they are worried about paying winter energy bills.
news.articleText: Energy bills help 'doesn't go far enough' - Published Households in the West Midlands said they want to see the government revisit energy bills in the wake of the Budget - amid concerns the help being offered won't go far enough. Chancellor John Healey announced a £100 'household energy payment', and a future plan to remove gas standing charges, as part of a wider package to address the cost of living. Families in the region told the BBC they were "grateful" for the assistance, but were concerned about their finances over the winter. Kelly Birkett, a personal accountant from Redditch, said: "The £100 is good, but it's not great. It just gets absorbed into everything else families have to pay for, just to get by." Birkett, a married mum-of-two, said her family was already considering what to cut back on in the wake of the Budget. "I know I sound a little but ungrateful for the £100, and I don't want to be. I'm certainly not ungrateful," she said. "But in reality we're no better off. With the temperatures dropping we know the heating will have to be on, the children can't be cold. "We'll dig deep to make sure we're a little more conservative when it comes to the heating, but for sure it's something most families will be worried about (the winter.)" Mark Sumner, a coach driver from Alcester, said him and his wife sold their previous home partly to clear old debts that had accrued from bills including energy. He told the BBC they had fallen into "energy debt" and were concerned about this coming winter. "We know our bill will go up again, you're just dreading it each time the increase comes around, as to how much it will be," he said. "I very rarely take our children out for anything to eat anymore, and we're very careful about what we spend at the shops. "What the government has announced is helpful. I don't want to be ungrateful so I will say it's helpful for us, but it probably only covers one month (of bills). "So it's a slight help, but it's not enough." 'We are being fair to families' The government said "millions of families" would benefit from the measures announced in the Budget, including freezing fuel duty, the 3.9% minimum wage increase and scrapping plans to reduce the £20,000 tax-free limit on ISAs. Chancellor John Healey said the energy announcement was "just a small part" of what the government was doing to help families. "Conflict in the Middle East and Europe is hitting families here at home through higher everyday costs," he said. "We can't control global events, but we can act where we can make a difference." There is no definitive date for scrapping the standing charge on gas, but the Treasury has committed to doing it either in 2027 or "as soon as possible after". The VAT cut on electricity bills, which was due to end in April, will be extended to July next year. news.title: Diwali hampers to bring hope to families in need
news.summary: The Diwali Basket Brigade volunteers want to help vulnerable households with rising food prices.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Diwali hampers to bring hope to families in need
news.summaryTr: The Diwali Basket Brigade volunteers want to help vulnerable households with rising food prices.
news.articleText: Diwali hampers to bring hope to families in need - Published Hundreds of volunteers have packed food parcels to distribute to people across Birmingham struggling with the rising cost of living. About 300 people turned up to the Diwali Basket Brigade event at the RSRS Centre in Hockley, which was organised by The Diwali Foundation. It is the ninth time the charity has brought community volunteers from a variety of backgrounds together to make hampers in the build up to the religious festival. Deepak Parekh, founder of the initiative, said: "[The] cost of living crisis hasn't gone away... but Diwali is a celebration of light over darkness, and this is our little way of bringing some light and some hope into the families that need it most." The Diwali Foundation, who are based in Herefordshire, said that more than 12% of UK households are experiencing food poverty. It works with about forty different food banks and charities to reach vulnerable households. To date, the charity said it has provided around 23,470 food hampers to those in need. Volunteer Clare Hannah said, while packing bags: "You're thinking about, 'oh I wonder what they're going to make with this'. And the fact that this is all that they've got, for some people." Parcels were taken from Hockley to residents living in homes provided by Walsall Housing Group (whg). Faye Shanahan from whg said: "It's really tough out there. Our customers are having a really hard time. The cost of living is not easing. "Events like this today are really, really fantastic. It makes an absolutely fantastic difference to our customers." Resident John Whiting, who turned 80 on Saturday, described his parcel as "unbelievable". "There are a lot of people out there that've got nothing," he added. "The food will be tremendous, thank you." A London event was also held on Saturday, with similar events in Manchester and Leicester planned for Sunday. Organisers have set a target of providing 6,000 food hampers this year, which would top a 2025 record when more than 80,000 meals were provided. news.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
news.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

news.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
news.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
news.articleText: Release Number 9316-26 CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig announced the CFTC’s plan to increase the publication frequency of the Commitments of Traders Report (COT Report) from once to twice a week by the end of 2026. Data from Monday will be published on Wednesday, and data from Wednesday will be published on Friday. Both reports will be released at 3:30 p.m. ET on their respective publication days. Under the enhanced publication schedule, the reports’ latency will decrease from three days to two days. The change follows the Commission’s recent Request for Comment and reflects its commitment to providing market participants with more timely information about trading positions and activity in agricultural markets. The CFTC’s Division of Data is leading the effort to operationalize the expanded publication schedule through modernization and automation while maintaining accuracy. “COT Reports have been an important source of transparency for decades. Following feedback from the agricultural community, I’m pleased to announce the CFTC will be rolling out COT Reports twice a week to ensure this information stream is as useful as possible,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction
news.articleText: Release Number 9315-26 CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission announced today it has filed a lawsuit against Utah to block the state’s efforts to shut down CFTC-registered contract markets using state laws. The lawsuit follows Utah’s decision to file civil enforcement actions in state court against CFTC-regulated markets and other businesses. Utah’s effort to restrict the functioning of CFTC-registered exchanges obstructs Congress’s decision to federally preempt state law. “Utah seeks to shut down prediction markets across a wide variety of markets,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Event contracts do not just serve hedging and investment purposes—they also provide the public with information about the outcome of future events. Congress entrusted the CFTC to be the federal regulator with sole responsibility to oversee these markets. As I’ve said before, the CFTC has the expertise and responsibility to defend its exclusive jurisdiction over commodity derivatives, and that’s exactly what we’ll do.” This action reflects the CFTC’s firm commitment to maintaining its exclusive jurisdiction over CFTC-registered prediction markets. The CFTC continues to draw a clear line: if a state challenges the lawful operation of a derivatives exchange, the Commission will protect federal sovereign interests. The Commission has also initiated legal proceedings against nine other states and has submitted briefs in four federal courts of appeal and one state supreme court. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC and National Basketball Association Sign MOU to Protect Integrity in Professional Basketball
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC and National Basketball Association Sign MOU to Protect Integrity in Professional Basketball
news.articleText: Release Number 9314-26 CFTC and National Basketball Association Sign MOU to Protect Integrity in Professional Basketball October 26, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the National Basketball Association today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to protect the integrity of professional basketball in prediction markets. Through the MOU, the CFTC and NBA will better share information by regularly communicating and discussing matters relating to integrity, as well as maintaining fair and transparent prediction markets. “I’m pleased the CFTC and NBA signed an MOU which continues the Commission’s commitment to increasing data sharing between the agency and professional sports leagues,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “The NBA joins the MLB and NHL in taking a responsible step toward protecting sports integrity and market participants from abuses in prediction markets like insider trading and fraud. I thank NBA Commissioner Adam Silver for putting the integrity of professional basketball and America’s financial markets first and for working with the CFTC on this MOU.” -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Louisiana Man and His Companies to Pay Over $9 Million in Forex Fraud
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Louisiana Man and His Companies to Pay Over $9 Million in Forex Fraud
news.articleText: Release Number 9313-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Louisiana Man and His Companies to Pay Over $9 Million in Forex Fraud October 21, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Louisiana entered a default judgment against defendants Michael B. DePetrillo, Meteor LLC, and NOLA FX Capital Management LLC for their participation in a fraudulent retail forex scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented that participant funds would be used to trade retail forex, made material misrepresentations and omissions regarding the profitability of forex trading with them, and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying DePetrillo’s personal expenses, and trading in DePetrillo’s personal account. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,211,492 civil monetary penalty. The order also permanently enjoins the defendants from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposes permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2024 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9003-24] On Feb. 18, 2025, in a related criminal case, DePetrillo pleaded guilty to violating the Commodity Exchange Act in connection with the same conduct in the CFTC’s complaint. On July 23, 2025, the court sentenced him to nine years in prison and ordered him to pay $6,748,412 in restitution. The CFTC appreciates the assistance of the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Eastern District of Louisiana and the FBI New Orleans Division. -CFTC-

items.title: Democrat endorses Republican candidate in key Michigan Senate race as party spat escalates
items.summary: Haley Stevens, who lost out on the Democratic Senate nomination to Abdul El-Sayed, endorses his opponent days before the vote.

items.titleTr: Democrat endorses Republican candidate in key Michigan Senate race as party spat escalates
items.summaryTr: Haley Stevens, who lost out on the Democratic Senate nomination to Abdul El-Sayed, endorses his opponent days before the vote.
items.articleText: Democrat endorses Republican candidate in key Michigan Senate race as party spat escalates - Published A Democrat in Michigan has endorsed the Republican candidate in the state's crucial US Senate contest, as a spat with her own party's candidate Abdul El-Sayed escalated just days before the vote. Haley Stevens, a sitting congresswoman who lost out on the Democratic Senate nomination to El-Sayed, made a surprise appearance alongside the Republican candidate Mike Rogers at a church on Sunday. "I don't belong in Abdul's campaign," she said in a video posted to X shortly after that appearance. "Who we are as Michiganders is not hate and is not what we are getting out from our Democratic nominee right now." "That's why I am endorsing Mike Rogers," Stevens said. Stevens also said El-Sayed had apparently told her she was no longer welcome in his campaign. "This is a very close election, we all know that, but Abdul made clear that I was not welcome in his campaign, that he didn't need me there, that he didn't want me there," Stevens told reporters after the Sunday church service. The pair had been scheduled to appear together at a different event on Sunday, but El-Sayed reportedly asked her not to come. They had clashed publicly over a campaign advert from an outside liberal group which blamed Israel for high food prices. El-Sayed criticised the advert and said he had nothing to do with its contents. When asked about Stevens' endorsement, El-Sayed told reporters he was focused on the problems Michiganders are facing. "At the end of the day, I don't think about Haley Stevens," he said. "None of this matters." In downtown Detroit, people were grabbing lunch or making their way to Ford Field stadium for the Detroit Lions American football game when the news broke. Every democrat that the BBC spoke with shared that they were disappointed by her endorsement of Rogers. Summer Lawrence, a 21-year-old student, told the BBC that Stevens' endorsement felt like a betrayal to the Democratic party and everything she told voters she stood for. "I just genuinely don't understand it," she said. "I do think it's a betrayal of the party because the things she stands for are not the same things that he stands for as a Republican." Matthew Barera, another Michigan voter told the BBC, he, too, did not understand Stevens' reasoning. "I don't know if she had her own revenge or not, maybe she had frustrations with the party in her own elections," he said. Others, including Republicans who support Rogers, said they doubted it would make a difference to the race. "People can see right through her actions, you know? She's just angry," Marissa Lee, a Rogers supporter, told the BBC. "She is not going to make anybody change their mind." The Michigan Senate race is considered by analysts to be one of the tightest in Tuesday's midterm elections, which will decide which party controls Congress for the next two years. It is one of a handful of battleground contests that will ultimately decide control of the Senate. The seat is currently held by a retiring Democrat and the last time a Republican was elected to this Senate seat was in 1994. But in presidential elections, it is one of the crucial swing states - Michigan voted for Democrat Joe Biden in 2020 but Trump in 2024. Rogers welcomed Stevens' endorsement and said it showed "courage" during brief remarks with reporters outside the church. President Donald Trump echoed that sentiment saying on Truth Social that, "[Stevens] showed great and almost unprecedented loyalty to the Great People of Michigan with what she did". Many of Stevens' staff reportedly resigned immediately after her announcement, while the chair of the Democratic Party in Michigan said her decision "shows that she has abandoned everything she claims to care about". "We reject the attempts by Stevens and bad-faith actors to divide our party and undermine our momentum," Curtis Hertel said in a statement. Over the weekend, as Stevens' criticism of El-Sayed escalated, a number of Democratic politicians in Michigan publicly encouraged her to end the feud and back the party's candidates more directly. items.articleText: Anthropic'ten yapay zekaya oyun freni: Claude artık yeniden oluşturamayacak - Anthropic'in Claude Code aracına, yapay zekanın mevcut video oyunlarını yeniden oluşturmasını engelleyen yeni bir talimat eklediği ortaya çıktı. XDA Developers'ın incelemesine göre kısıtlama, özellikle Opus 5.5 modelinde aktif. - Düzenlemenin oyun portları ve tersine mühendislik projelerini nasıl etkileyeceği ise belirsizliğini koruyor. Yapay zeka destekli oyun geliştirme projelerine yönelik yeni bir kısıtlama gündeme geldi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Anthropic'in kodlama aracı Claude Code'a, yapay zeka modellerinin mevcut bir video oyununun aynısını yeniden oluşturmasını engelleyen bir talimat eklediği bildirildi. XDA Developers'ın haberine göre söz konusu talimat, belirli bir oyunun ismi değiştirilerek veya özgün bir proje gibi sunularak yeniden oluşturulmasını da kapsıyor. Talimatın, Anthropic sunucularından Claude Code’a iletilen bir yapılandırma üzerinden uygulandığı belirtildi. Claude Code'un sisteminde yeni talimat bulundu Söz konusu kısıtlama ilk olarak X platformunda bir kullanıcı ve YouTuber tarafından paylaşıldı. XDA Developers ise talimatı Claude Code’un 2.1.314 sürümündeki yazılım dosyalarında bağımsız olarak doğruladığını açıkladı. Talimatın içeriğinde, Claude’un özgün oyunlar, belirli bir türden esinlenen yapımlar ve kullanıcıların kendi tasarım ve varlıklarıyla oluşturduğu projelere yardımcı olabileceği belirtiliyor. Buna karşılık, adı değiştirilse veya özgün olduğu iddia edilse bile mevcut bir oyunun yeniden oluşturulmasına destek verilmemesi isteniyor. XDA’nın incelemesi, kısıtlamanın Opus 5.5 modeline ayrı bir mekanizma üzerinden de iletilebildiğini ortaya koydu. Ancak düzenlemenin tüm kullanıcılara ve modellere ne ölçüde yayıldığı henüz net değil. Pokémon ve Zelda projeleri etkilenebilir XDA’nın yaptığı testlerde Claude Opus 5.5, Pokémon Diamond oyununun yeniden oluşturulmasına yönelik talepleri reddetti. Model, mevcut bir oyunun yeniden yaratılmasının oturum talimatlarıyla yasaklandığını belirtti. Buna karşılık, oyunun kodlarının incelenmesi ve tersine mühendislik çalışmaları konusunda farklı yanıtlar verdi. Opus 5.5, decompile işlemlerine yardımcı olabileceğini, ayrıştırılmış kodları daha okunabilir hale getirebileceğini ve kullanıcının kendi oyun kopyası üzerinden yeniden derleme araçları geliştirebileceğini ifade etti. Bu ayrım, özellikle eski oyunları farklı platformlarda çalıştırmayı amaçlayan projeler açısından önem taşıyor. Zelda: Wind Waker HD gibi oyunların bilgisayarlara taşınmasını sağlayan statik yeniden derleme projeleri ile Nintendo Switch oyunlarını Mac üzerinde çalıştırmayı hedefleyen uyumluluk araçlarının yeni kısıtlamadan nasıl etkileneceği belirsiz. Oyun geliştiricilerinden kısıtlama tepkisi XDA'nın aktardığına göre bir geliştirici, 30 Ekim’de Anthropic'in GitHub sayfasında Claude'un ücretli müşteriler için hazırladığı dijital masa ve savaş oyunu modüllerine yardımcı olmayı reddettiğini bildirdi. Geliştirici, projelerin müşterilerin sahip olduğu fiziksel oyunlardan ve sağladıkları materyallerden hareketle kişiselleştirildiğini belirtti. Anthropic’in kısıtlamayı ne kadar geniş uygulayacağına ilişkin henüz net bir açıklaması bulunmuyor. Şirketin oyun portları, decompile ve yeniden derleme projelerine yaklaşımı konusunda XDA’nın yönelttiği sorulara da haberin yayımlandığı sırada yanıt verilmediği aktarıldı. Statik yeniden derleme, mevcut bir oyunun talimatlarını farklı bir platformda çalışabilecek biçime dönüştürür. Bu yöntem, oyunu sıfırdan yeniden oluşturmak yerine orijinal kodun başka bir sistemde çalışmasını sağlamayı amaçlar. Claude'a getirilen yeni talimatın bu tür çalışmaları kapsayıp kapsamadığı henüz kesinleşmiş değil.

items.summary: A rare humanitarian ceasefire has allowed civilians to evacuate the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky.

items.titleTr: Russian strikes cut power to thousands in Ukraine as Kherson ceasefire to end
items.summaryTr: A rare humanitarian ceasefire has allowed civilians to evacuate the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky.
items.articleText: Russian strikes cut power to thousands in Ukraine as Kherson ceasefire to end - Published A rare humanitarian ceasefire in Ukraine's Kherson region, that has allowed civilians to evacuate the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky, is due to end on Sunday night. While the localised ceasefire on the front line has held since it was implemented last week, fighting has continued elsewhere. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said Russia had struck energy infrastructure in four regions overnight on Saturday, leaving hundreds of thousands of homes without power. Another overnight strike killed two people, including a 13-year-old girl, in the Vinnytsia region, the State Emergency Service of Ukraine said. Meanwhile, Ukraine hit a major missile fuel producer in Russia's Rostov region, which caused a fire and damaged four production facilities, Zelensky said. In Ukraine, repair works to restore power continued throughout the day. Most customers in the Dnipropetrovsk region had their connections restored by early evening, but more than 60,000 were still without power, the governor said. Because of regular attacks on energy infrastructure, emergency power cuts have been introduced across the country. Even in the capital Kyiv, electricity is cut off for most of the day, and water supplies are also disrupted. Zelensky said in a social media post that the intensity of Russian strikes has been "extremely high" over the past week, adding that Russia was "trying to take maximum advantage of the shortage of ballistic missile interceptors". He added that "every day" Ukraine communicated its need for Patriot missiles - the only effective weapon for downing Russia's deadly ballistic missiles - to the US, Europe and other partners. He thanked countries for their support so far and longer-term commitments, but called again for more immediate aid. On the front line, a localised ceasefire in the Kherson region was due to end at 22:59 Ukrainian time (21:00 GMT) on Sunday. The limited pause in hostilities, which started on Tuesday, was brokered with the help of US First Lady Melania Trump and Pope Leo. It was originally confined to the city of Oleshky, which has been occupied by Russia since the first days of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, and was expanded across the wider region of Kherson. Oleshky had been trapped on one side by the Dnipro river and the other by Russian forces, with routes out mined and subject to drone attack. Residents trapped there were suffering severe shortages of food, water and electricity, with many resorting to cooking garden weeds to survive. The truce allowed for Oleskhy residents to evacuate if they wanted, and there were emotional scenes on Saturday of reunions between loved ones who hadn't seen eachother for years. There are Ukrainian military positions just 5km (3.1 miles) from Oleshky, but evacuees had to travel through Russian-occupied territory to southern Russia, where they flew to Belarus, before finally being driven across Ukraine's northern border. The oldest evacuee was 94 years old, while the youngest was one, according to Dmytro Lubinets, Ukraine's human rights ombudsman. Related topics - Published1 day ago

items.articleText: Putin ile Zelenskiy masaya oturacak mı? Kremlin’den açıklama - Kremlin Dış Politika Danışmanı Yuriy Uşakov, Ukrayna Devlet Başkanı Volodimir Zelenskiy’nin araması halinde Rusya Devlet Başkanı Vladimir Putin’in görüşmeye hazır olduğunu söyledi. - Uşakov, Putin’in görüşmekten hiçbir zaman vazgeçmediğini belirtti. Kremlin’den Ukrayna ile olası müzakerelere ilişkin dikkat çeken bir açıklama geldi. Rusya Devlet Başkanı Vladimir Putin’in Dış Politika Danışmanı Yuriy Uşakov, Ukrayna Devlet Başkanı Volodimir Zelenskiy’nin telefon etmesi halinde Putin’in çağrıyı yanıtlayacağını söyledi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Rus televizyon kanalı Rossiya’ya konuşan Uşakov, Ukrayna krizinin çözümüne yönelik diplomatik temasları değerlendirdi. “Buyursun gelsin” Zelenskiy’nin Putin ile Moskova’da görüşebileceğini belirten Uşakov, Ukrayna liderinin farklı kanallar üzerinden görüşme isteğine ilişkin sinyaller gönderdiğini ifade etti. Uşakov, "Madem bu kadar görüşmek istiyor, buyursun gelsin." dedi. Zelenskiy’nin Putin’i araması halinde Rus liderin telefonu açıp açmayacağı sorusunu da yanıtlayan Uşakov, “Putin'in açacağını düşünüyorum. Putin, hiçbir zaman görüşmekten vazgeçmedi” ifadelerini kullandı. Abu Dabi’de üçlü müzakere mesajı Uşakov, Ukrayna konusunda Birleşik Arap Emirlikleri’nin başkenti Abu Dabi’de yapılması planlanan üçlü müzakerelere Avrupalı temsilcilerin katılması ihtimalini de değerlendirdi. Rusya, Ukrayna ve ABD arasında yürütülmesi planlanan üçlü görüşmeler, savaşın sona erdirilmesine yönelik diplomatik girişimlerin önemli başlıklarından biri olarak öne çıkıyor.

items.titleTr: Peaceful protests in Germany spiral into violence and looting
items.summaryTr: Thousands joined largely orderly demonstrations earlier in the day, before violence erupted in Frankfurt, Berlin, Cologne and Hamburg.
items.articleText: Peaceful protests in Germany spiral into violence and looting Rioters looted shops in central Frankfurt late on Saturday as clashes erupted in German cities over the cost of living. The rallies were organised by the campaign group Gen Z regelt - meaning "Gen Z takes charge". Thousands had taken part in the largely peaceful demonstrations across Germany before violence broke out. At least 54 people were arrested in Frankfurt and over 100 police officers left injured, according to German authorities. Besides Frankfurt - Germany's financial hub - there were outbreaks of violence in Berlin, Cologne and Hamburg. This comes as protests have been taking place across Europe over the rising cost of living, poor public services, and a lack of affordable housing. The BBC's world correspondent Joe Inwood reports.

items.titleTr: 31 yaşındaki kadının ölümünde ChatGPT iddiası: Aile hukuk mücadelesi başlattı
items.summaryTr: ABD’de yaşayan 31 yaşındaki yazılım mühendisi Bowen Wan, epilepsi tedavisinde kullandığı ilacın dozunu ChatGPT’nin önerileri doğrultusunda azalttıktan sonra hayatını kaybetti.
items.articleText: 31 yaşındaki kadının ölümünde ChatGPT iddiası: Aile hukuk mücadelesi başlattı - ABD'de yaşayan 31 yaşındaki yazılım mühendisi Bowen Wan, epilepsi tedavisinde kullandığı ilacın dozunu ChatGPT'nin önerileri doğrultusunda azalttıktan sonra hayatını kaybetti. - Ailesi, sohbet robotunun doktor kontrolünü devre dışı bırakan tavsiyelerde bulunduğunu öne sürerek OpenAI ve CEO’su Sam Altman’a dava açtı. ABD'de yaşayan 31 yaşındaki yazılım mühendisi Bowen Wan'ın ölümü, yapay zeka araçlarının sağlık konularındaki rolünü yeniden gündeme taşıdı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Ailesinin açtığı davaya dayanan New York Times haberine göre Wan, epilepsi tedavisinde kullandığı ilacın dozunu ChatGPT ile yaptığı görüşmelerin ardından kendi başına azaltmaya başladı. Wan, şubat ayında Seattle'daki evinde ölü bulundu. Ölümünün, epilepsiye bağlı ani beklenmedik ölüm (SUDEP) komplikasyonundan kaynaklandığı belirtildi. Ailesi, genç kadının ölümünden önceki günlerde ChatGPT’den ilaç dozunu nasıl azaltabileceğine ilişkin tavsiyeler aldığını ileri sürdü. ChatGPT ile kurduğu ilişki zamanla yoğunlaştı 2021 yılında epilepsi nöbetleri sıklaşan Wan, Amazon'daki yazılım mühendisliği görevinden sağlık sorunları nedeniyle izin aldı. Sosyal hayattan giderek uzaklaşan Wan, 2023 yılında ChatGPT2yi ilişki tavsiyeleri almak ve sigorta ile engellilik yardımları gibi konularda destek almak için kullanmaya başladı. Ailesinin aktardığına göre 2025 yılına gelindiğinde chatbot ile haftada ortalama 1.500 mesajlaşıyordu. Aynı dönemde ailesiyle daha az iletişim kurmaya başladı. Wan, Mart 2025'te ChatGPT'ye yazdığı bir mesajda, sohbet ederken onu bir arkadaş gibi görmeye başladığını ifade etti. İlaç dozunu azaltma süreci Habere göre Wan, Amazon’daki işinden çıkarılmasının ardından yeni bir iş bulabilmek için bilişsel becerilerini ve konuşma yeteneğini etkilediğini düşündüğü ilaçların dozunu azaltmayı değerlendirdi. Ocak 2026'da epilepsi ilacının günlük dozunu 400 miligramdan önce 300, ardından 200 miligrama indirmek için ChatGPT'den tavsiye istedi. Chatbot başlangıçta doktora danışmasını önerse de daha sonraki görüşmelerde Wan'ı doktor reçetesine bağlı kalmama konusunda desteklediği iddia edildi. Wan'ın babası Qun Wan, kızının ChatGPT ile yaptığı görüşmelerde ilacın dozunu birkaç hafta içinde tamamen sıfırlamaya yönelik bir plan oluşturduğunu sonradan öğrendi. İlaç dozunun düşürülmesiyle birlikte Wan’da kafa karışıklığı ve hafıza sorunları gibi belirtiler ortaya çıktı. Ailenin dava dosyasına göre genç kadın, yaşadığı sorunlarla ilgili toplam 158 kez endişesini dile getirdi. Ancak chatbotun bu belirtileri önemsemeyerek beyninin "düşük güç modunda" olduğu yönünde yanıtlar verdiği öne sürüldü. Wan’ın son mesajını, cesedinin bulunmasından üç gün önce gönderdiği belirtildi. Aile OpenAI ve Sam Altman’a dava açtı Wan ailesi, OpenAI ve şirketin CEO'su Sam Altman'a karşı haksız ölüm davası açtı. Ailenin avukatları, ChatGPT'nin lisansı olmadan tıbbi tavsiyelerde bulunduğunu ve doktorları danışılması gereken uzmanlar yerine aşılması gereken engeller gibi gösterdiğini savundu. OpenAI sözcüsü Drew Pusateri ise New York Times'a yaptığı açıklamada olayın son derece üzücü olduğunu belirtti. Pusateri, Wan'ın kullandığı GPT-4o modelinin artık kullanılamadığını ve ChatGPT'nin tıbbi bakımın yerini tutmadığını vurguladı. Şirket, yapay zekanın sağlık bilgilerini anlamak, sigorta süreçlerinde yol göstermek ve doktor randevularına hazırlanmak gibi alanlarda yardımcı olabileceğini savundu. Epilepside ani ölüm riski Epilepsi, dünya genelinde milyonlarca kişiyi etkileyen nörolojik bir hastalık. Hastalığın en ciddi komplikasyonlarından biri olan epilepside ani beklenmedik ölüm (SUDEP), çoğunlukla gece veya uyku sırasında gerçekleşiyor. Epilepsi Vakfı verilerine göre epilepsili her 1.000 yetişkinden yaklaşık biri her yıl bu nedenle hayatını kaybediyor. Nöbetlerin kontrol altında tutulması, riski azaltmanın en önemli yollarından biri olarak gösteriliyor.

items.titleTr: Fenerbahçe'den yönetim krizi iddialarına yanıt: "Tamamen gerçek dışı"
items.summaryTr: Fenerbahçe Spor Kulübü, Başkan Aziz Yıldırım ve bazı yöneticiler hakkında ortaya atılan yönetim krizi iddialarına ilişkin açıklama yaptı. Sarı lacivertli kulüp, söz konusu haberlerin gerçeği yansıtmadığını bildirdi.
items.articleText: Fenerbahçe'den yönetim krizi iddialarına yanıt: "Tamamen gerçek dışı" - Fenerbahçe Kulübü, Aziz Yıldırım ve yöneticiler hakkında ortaya atılan Barcelona seyahati ve yönetim krizi iddialarını yalanladı. - Kulüp, yöneticilerin tarifeli uçakla Barcelona-Real Madrid maçını izlediğini belirterek istifa iddialarının gerçeği yansıtmadığını açıkladı. Fenerbahçe Kulübü, Başkan Aziz Yıldırım ve bazı yöneticiler hakkında gündeme gelen yönetim krizi iddialarına ilişkin açıklama yaptı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Kulüp, Elis Buse Araç tarafından paylaşılan iddiaların tamamen gerçek dışı olduğunu bildirdi. Kulübün açıklamasında, yöneticiler Batuhan Özdemir ve Savaş Adalet'in tarifeli uçakla seyahat ederek Barcelona-Real Madrid karşılaşmasını yerinde takip ettiği belirtildi. Haberde adı geçen Ömer Onan'ın ise son iki yıldır Barcelona'ya gitmediği ifade edildi. İstifa iddialarına yalanlama Açıklamada, Aziz Yıldırım'ın yöneticilere futbol takımıyla ilgili herhangi bir görev verdiği, Barcelona seyahati nedeniyle tepki gösterdiği veya istifalarını istediği yönündeki iddiaların gerçeği yansıtmadığı vurgulandı. Haberde aktarılan konuşmaların yaşanmadığı ve iddia edildiği gibi bir yönetim krizinin bulunmadığı kaydedildi. Fenerbahçe yönetimi, kulübün hassas bir dönemden geçtiğine dikkat çekerek yönetim içinde ayrışma olduğu algısı yaratmaya yönelik asılsız haberlere itibar edilmemesi çağrısında bulundu.

items.title: Armed police start patrols in Sydney after Bondi Beach attack
items.summary: The new police unit is a security measure in response to last year's deadly shooting attack at a Hanukkah festival.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Armed police start patrols in Sydney after Bondi Beach attack
items.summaryTr: The new police unit is a security measure in response to last year's deadly shooting attack at a Hanukkah festival.
items.articleText: Armed police start patrols in Sydney after Bondi Beach attack - Published Heavily-armed police officers have started patrolling Sydney's streets, as part of heightened security measures following last year's deadly shooting at Bondi Beach. The Armed Response Command (ARC) will see specially trained officers in busy tourist areas carrying long-arm rifles – an unfamiliar sight for most residents. New South Wales police say the officers will also patrol major events like sports matches and places of worship "to prevent, deter and rapidly respond to serious threats, including active armed offender incidents". Fifteen people - including a 10-year-old girl – were killed in December when two gunmen opened fire on an event marking the Jewish festival of Hanukkah at the popular beach. The attack was Australia's worst mass shooting in almost three decades and prompted sweeping gun law reforms and a crackdown on hate speech. One resident told ABC news that the sight of armed police was "unnerving". "They are just everywhere. Those guns are huge." But another woman told the broadcaster that seeing police with weapons made her feel safe. ARC is specifically designed to be "highly visible across Sydney, driving specialist vehicles and carrying rifles," New South Wales police said in a statement. Its role "is built on a simple principle - preserving life," Detective Superintendent Andrew Evans said. The shooting on 14 December put huge pressure on Prime Minister Anthony Albanese's government, with calls for immediate action on antisemitism. Jewish communities have welcomed the new police operation, which will eventually consist of 250 officers, but others have called for safeguards to protect human rights. "No Australian wants to see officers with military weapons on our streets, but the sight of body bags is far worse," Alex Ryvchin, co-CEO of Executive Council of Australian Jewry, said. But Amnesty International Australia said it was concerned about the "militarisation of policing", and asked for assurances from the state government that ARC will not be used to suppress peaceful protests. "Any expansion of police powers and capabilities must be accompanied by clear, publicly accessible rules, robust independent oversight and accountability," said the organisation's Andrew Witheford. The New South Wales administration defended the new measures. "Our world changed forever. That's just the truth of it, right across this country. And I said it at the time, we will never be the same again," the state's Police Minister Yasmin Catley told the ABC. One of the alleged gunmen, Naveed Akram, has been charged with 78 offences including 15 counts of murder, 40 counts of attempted murder, and one count of committing a terrorist act. items.articleTextTr: Armed police start patrols in Sydney after Bondi Beach attack - Published Heavily-armed police officers have started patrolling Sydney's streets, as part of heightened security measures following last year's deadly shooting at Bondi Beach. The Armed Response Command (ARC) will see specially trained officers in busy tourist areas carrying long-arm rifles – an unfamiliar sight for most residents. New South Wales police say the officers will also patrol major events like sports matches and places of worship "to prevent, deter and rapidly respond to serious threats, including active armed offender incidents". Fifteen people - including a 10-year-old girl – were killed in December when two gunmen opened fire on an event marking the Jewish festival of Hanukkah at the popular beach. The attack was Australia's worst mass shooting in almost three decades and prompted sweeping gun law reforms and a crackdown on hate speech. One resident told ABC news that the sight of armed police was "unnerving". "They are just everywhere. Those guns are huge." But another woman told the broadcaster that seeing police with weapons made her feel safe. ARC is specifically designed to be "highly visible across Sydney, driving specialist vehicles and carrying rifles," New South Wales police said in a statement. Its role "is built on a simple principle - preserving life," Detective Superintendent Andrew Evans said. The shooting on 14 December put huge pressure on Prime Minister Anthony Albanese's government, with calls for immediate action on antisemitism. Jewish communities have welcomed the new police operation, which will eventually consist of 250 officers, but others have called for safeguards to protect human rights. "No Australian wants to see officers with military weapons on our streets, but the sight of body bags is far worse," Alex Ryvchin, co-CEO of Executive Council of Australian Jewry, said. But Amnesty International Australia said it was concerned about the "militarisation of policing", and asked for assurances from the state government that ARC will not be used to suppress peaceful protests. "Any expansion of police powers and capabilities must be accompanied by clear, publicly accessible rules, robust independent oversight and accountability," said the organisation's Andrew Witheford. The New South Wales administration defended the new measures. "Our world changed forever. That's just the truth of it, right across this country. And I said it at the time, we will never be the same again," the state's Police Minister Yasmin Catley told the ABC. One of the alleged gunmen, Naveed Akram, has been charged with 78 offences including 15 counts of murder, 40 counts of attempted murder, and one count of committing a terrorist act.
