items.summaryTr: ABD Başkanı Donald Trump ile Kanada Başbakanı Mark Carney, iki ülke arasında uzun süredir devam eden ticaret anlaşmazlıklarını telefonda görüştü. Carney, görüşmenin yapıcı geçtiğini belirtirken, ekiplerin önümüzdeki haftalarda anlaşma için çalışacağını açıkladı.
items.articleText: Trump ve Carney arasında kritik telefon görüşmesi: Ticaret anlaşmasında yeni adım - ABD Başkanı Donald Trump ile Kanada Başbakanı Mark Carney, iki ülke arasında uzun süredir devam eden ticaret anlaşmazlıklarını telefonda görüştü. - Carney, görüşmenin yapıcı geçtiğini belirtirken, ekiplerin önümüzdeki haftalarda anlaşma için çalışacağını açıkladı. ABD ile Kanada arasındaki ticaret geriliminde diplomatik temaslar hız kazandı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Kanada Başbakanı Mark Carney ile ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, iki ülke arasındaki ticaret ilişkilerinin geleceğini ele almak üzere telefonda görüştü. Carney, ABD merkezli X platformundaki hesabından yaptığı açıklamada, görüşmenin olumlu geçtiğini ve karşılıklı fayda sağlayacak bir ticaret anlaşmasının ana hatlarının ele alındığını bildirdi. Görüşmenin, iki ülke arasında daha önce gerçekleştirilen yapıcı temasların devamı niteliğinde olduğunu belirten Carney, hedeflenen anlaşmanın çalışanlar için istihdam yaratmasını ve ailelerin satın alma gücünü artırmasını amaçladığını ifade etti. Carney ayrıca anlaşmanın Kanada'nın dillerine, kültürüne ve egemenliğine tam anlamıyla saygı göstermesi gerektiğini vurguladı. Ekipler önümüzdeki haftalarda çalışacak Kanada Başbakanı, iki ülkenin ekiplerinin önümüzdeki haftalarda anlaşmaya yönelik sonuç elde etmek için çalışmalarını sürdüreceğini kaydetti. ABD ile Kanada arasında özellikle Trump'ın ikinci başkanlık döneminde gümrük tarifeleri ve ticaret politikaları nedeniyle gerilim yaşanmıştı. Carney, 27 Ekim'de yaptığı açıklamada, ABD'nin kırmızı çizgilerinin kabul edilmesi halinde ticaret anlaşmasına ulaşma ihtimalinin artacağını söylemişti. Trump da Michigan'da düzenlediği seçim konuşmasında Kanada ile ticaret meselesinin yakında çözüme kavuşturulacağını ifade etmişti. ABD ve Kanada ticareti neden önemli? ABD ve Kanada, birbirlerinin en büyük ticaret ortakları arasında yer alıyor. İki ülke arasındaki ticaret; otomotiv, enerji, çelik, alüminyum ve tarım gibi sektörlerde yoğunlaşıyor. Gümrük tarifelerine ilişkin anlaşmazlıklar, sınır ötesi tedarik zincirleri ve şirketlerin maliyetleri üzerinde doğrudan etkili olabiliyor.

items.title: Lindsay Clancy is back in court - where will her case go next?
items.summary: The Massachusetts mother, accused of murdering her three children, is expected back in court as she awaits a decision on whether her case will be retried.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Lindsay Clancy is back in court - where will her case go next?
items.summaryTr: The Massachusetts mother, accused of murdering her three children, is expected back in court as she awaits a decision on whether her case will be retried.
items.articleText: Lindsay Clancy is back in court - where will her case go next? - Published Lindsay Clancy, the US woman accused of murdering her three children, will return to a Massachusetts court on Monday as lawyers debate retrying the case. Her defence team and Massachusetts prosecutors are expected to discuss how to move forward, with both parties seeking different outcomes. Last week, in response to a defence request to dismiss the trial, prosecutors offered their clearest hint yet that they are seeking a new trial before a different jury. "The Commonwealth [Massachusetts] should be permitted to continue to pursue justice for Cora, Dawson and Callan Clancy," her three children, prosecutors said. Prosecutors could also reduce the charges in a potential second trial or dismiss them altogether. Clancy's first trial ended in a mistrial after a 12-person jury failed to reach a consensus. The 36-year-old has not denied killing her children in 2023, but her defence team argues she was suffering from severe postpartum psychosis at the time. Prosecutors say the killings were intentional. What happened when Clancy was last in court? A jury first heard Clancy's case in August 2026, but failed to reach a unanimous agreement on whether the prosecution had proved Clancy was guilty "beyond a reasonable doubt" as required by US law. A judge declared a mistrial in early September. At a court appearance later that month, Clancy's lawyer, Kevin Reddington, argued the judge should dismiss her case. Meanwhile, prosecutors said the state had "met its burden" in proving her guilt. But the hours-long back-and-forth ultimately didn't lead to a clearer answer about what might come next for Clancy - a dismissal of charges, retrial of the same charges, or retrial of lesser charges. These discussions will resume on Monday. Judge William Sullivan seemed confident the case would be retried, saying in September he wanted to "get this thing moving". He asked both sides to prepare to discuss possible trial dates at the November hearing. Reddington said he would be unable to go to trial until at least June 2027 if the case was retried. District Attorney Timothy Cruz said at the time that prosecutors had not yet decided whether to retry Clancy. "We're doing our due diligence; we're going to continue doing that," he said. "We're going to do what we can for the children. That's what this case is about." What do Clancy's legal team want? Fundamentally, Clancy's legal team - with Reddington at the helm - is pushing for the charges to be dismissed or dropped. They've explored a variety of legal avenues. In September, he asked for her to be found not guilty under Rule 25 - a Massachusetts provision that states a defendant should be found not guilty if prosecutors do not present enough evidence at trial. That request was denied. Judge Sullivan will hear arguments on several motions on Monday, but Heather Cucolo, a New York Law School professor and mental health law expert, told the BBC that the hearing will likely focus on a narrow point: was this an instance of a routine deadlocked-jury mistrial - in which the jury genuinely could not agree - or was this an improperly terminated trial? She said Reddington may argue that a retrial could violate Clancy's Constitutional protection against double jeopardy - a legal standard that says a person cannot be tried for the same crime twice. But legal experts agree that outcome is unlikely. "The public attention that's been put on this trial and the need to have some conclusion in the near future, I think that the judge is going to say that this mistrial was appropriate, was legally accurate, and that they need to now look to set a date for a retrial," Cucolo said. What do prosecutors want? While the state's legal team has not explicitly said they will pursue a retrial, Cruz and the prosecutors who argued the case have consistently said they want justice for Clancy's children. Last week, prosecutors asked Judge Sullivan to reject the motion to dismiss charges against Clancy on the grounds of double jeopardy. They argue mistrial procedures were properly followed by the court, and thus they have a right to seek justice again on behalf of the children. "Because a mistrial was properly declared due to the manifest necessity of a deadlocked jury, the defendant's motion to dismiss should be denied," prosecutors wrote in the motion. What could happen on 2 November? Judge Sullivan could make a determination over whether the case can proceed on Monday or he could rule later in writing, criminal defence lawyer Elyse Hershon told the BBC. And how the District Attorney's office wants to proceed could be determined ahead of Monday's hearing, during it or even days after, she said. "The three charges of first-degree murder are still pending; they are still hanging over Lindsay Clancy's head unless and until the DA announces otherwise," Hershon said. Historically, Cruz, the district attorney, has made comments and announcements about the case at press conferences after court finishes. That could happen again this week, she predicted. It is also likely, Hershon said, that Judge Sullivan pushes the lawyers on both sides to get a trial date on the calendar during Monday's hearing. "It does not mean it's definitely going to be a jury trial, but [they will want to] put something in the books, hold those dates. It's a big chunk of time. It's four, five, six weeks of the court calendar; that's hard to fit in at the last minute," she said. "I would anticipate they block off the time while they go through all these motions and the DA's office figures out what it wants to do." items.summary: ING, 3 Kasım'da yapılacak ABD ara seçimlerinin küresel ekonomi ve piyasalar üzerinde önemli etkiler yaratabileceğine dikkat çekti. Bankaya göre seçimlerin ardından Kongre'de oluşabilecek güç dengesi; Trump'ın İran politikasından gümrük tarifelerine birçok başlığı etkileyebilir.

items.articleText: ABD seçimleri piyasaların seyrini değiştirebilir: ING'den 5 kritik başlık ING, 3 Kasım'da yapılacak ABD ara seçimlerinin küresel ekonomi ve piyasalar üzerinde önemli etkiler yaratabileceğine dikkat çekti. Bankaya göre seçimlerin ardından Kongre'de oluşabilecek güç dengesi; Trump'ın İran politikasından gümrük tarifelerine birçok başlığı etkileyebilir. ABD'de 3 Kasım'da yapılacak Kongre ara seçimleri yaklaşırken, küresel piyasalar açısından olası sonuçlar da gündeme geliyor. ING, seçimlerin Ortadoğu'daki gelişmeler, yapay zeka yatırımları ve ticaret politikaları üzerinden küresel ekonomiyi etkileyebileceğini değerlendirdi. ING ekonomisti James Smith, seçimlerin ardından Washington'da bölünmüş bir yönetim ortaya çıkmasının ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ı dış politika ve gümrük tarifeleri gibi yürütme yetkisinin daha geniş olduğu alanlara yöneltebileceğini belirtti. Demokratların Kongre'de çoğunluğu İran politikasını etkileyebilir ING'ye göre Demokratların Kongre'de çoğunluğu elde etmesi, Trump yönetiminin İran politikasında iki farklı sonuç doğurabilir. İç politikada yasama faaliyetlerinin zorlaşması, Trump'ın dış politikaya daha fazla ağırlık vermesine yol açabilir. Diğer taraftan Demokratların Kongre'deki etkisinin artması, İran savaşı ve bu savaşın finansmanına yönelik itirazları güçlendirebilir. ABD Başkan Yardımcısı JD Vance'in İran'a gönderdiği mektup diplomatik çözüm ihtimaline işaret ederken, bölgeye ilave ABD askeri kapasitesi gönderildiğine ilişkin haberler yeni saldırı olasılığını gündemde tutuyor. ING, çatışmalarda yeni bir tırmanış yaşanmaması halinde enerji fiyatlarında oluşan yüksek risk priminin bir bölümünün ortadan kalkabileceğini öngördü. Yapay zeka yatırımları seçim gündeminde ING'nin değerlendirmesinde yapay zeka yatırımlarının siyasi boyutu da öne çıktı. ABD'de yapay zeka bağlantılı yatırımların yıllık yüzde 20'nin üzerinde arttığı, diğer sektörlerdeki sermaye harcamalarının ise zayıf seyrettiği belirtildi. Özellikle veri merkezlerinin hızla yaygınlaşmasının siyasi tartışma konusu haline geldiğine dikkat çekildi. Araştırmalara göre yaklaşık 12 milyon Amerikalı bir veri merkezinin 2 kilometre yakınında yaşıyor. ING, ara seçimlerin 2028 başkanlık seçimleri öncesinde yapay zeka altyapısına yönelik yatırımların ne ölçüde siyasi tartışmaya dönüşeceğini gösterebileceğini değerlendirdi. Trump yönetiminden Avrupa'ya yeni tarife gelebilir ING, ABD'de federal bütçe açığının gayrisafi yurt içi hasılanın (GSYH) yaklaşık yüzde 6'sına ulaştığını ve Kongre'de bu açığı anlamlı ölçüde azaltmaya yönelik güçlü bir eğilim bulunmadığını belirtti. Bölünmüş yönetimin bütçe ve maliye politikalarında uzlaşmayı zorlaştırabileceğine dikkat çeken banka, Trump yönetiminin özellikle Avrupa'ya yönelik yeni gümrük tarifelerine başvurabileceği uyarısında bulundu. ABD Yüksek Mahkemesi'nin acil durum tarifelerini iptal etmesinin ardından uygulanan geçici yüzde 10'luk genel tarifelerin yerini, 301. madde kapsamında daha kalıcı bir tarife yapısının aldığı hatırlatıldı. Fed için aralık ayında faiz artışı beklentisi ING, ABD'de açıklanacak ekim ayı istihdam raporunda tarım dışı istihdamın yaklaşık 75 bin kişi artmasını, işsizlik oranının ise yüzde 4,2 seviyesinde kalmasını bekliyor. Piyasaların Fed'in 9 Aralık toplantısında faiz artırımı ihtimalini yüzde 80 olarak fiyatladığını belirten banka, bu beklentiyi makul bulduğunu bildirdi. İngiltere'de faiz artışı, Euro Bölgesi'nde yüzde 4 enflasyon beklentisi ING, İngiltere Merkez Bankası'nın gelecek perşembe günü yapılacak toplantıda 7'ye karşı 2 oyla faiz artırmasını bekliyor. Banka, şubat ayında ikinci bir faiz artışının da gündeme gelebileceğini öngörüyor. Euro Bölgesi'nde ise yükselen enerji maliyetleri nedeniyle enflasyonun gelecek hafta yüzde 4'e ulaşabileceği tahmin ediliyor. Doğalgaz fiyatlarındaki yükselişin sürmesi halinde enflasyon üzerindeki yukarı yönlü risklerin devam edeceği belirtiliyor. ING'ye göre Avrupa Merkez Bankası, önümüzdeki dönemde özellikle enerji dışındaki fiyat gelişmelerini, çekirdek enflasyonu ve gıda fiyatlarını yakından izleyecek. Kongre'de çoğunluğun el değiştirmesi; bütçe, vergi düzenlemeleri, ticaret politikaları ve dış politika kararlarının uygulanmasını etkileyebiliyor. Bu nedenle seçim sonuçları yalnızca ABD piyasaları değil, dolar, tahvil faizleri, enerji fiyatları ve küresel ticaret açısından da yakından takip ediliyor.
items.articleTextTr: ABD seçimleri piyasaların seyrini değiştirebilir: ING'den 5 kritik başlık ING, 3 Kasım'da yapılacak ABD ara seçimlerinin küresel ekonomi ve piyasalar üzerinde önemli etkiler yaratabileceğine dikkat çekti. Bankaya göre seçimlerin ardından Kongre'de oluşabilecek güç dengesi; Trump'ın İran politikasından gümrük tarifelerine birçok başlığı etkileyebilir. ABD'de 3 Kasım'da yapılacak Kongre ara seçimleri yaklaşırken, küresel piyasalar açısından olası sonuçlar da gündeme geliyor. ING, seçimlerin Ortadoğu'daki gelişmeler, yapay zeka yatırımları ve ticaret politikaları üzerinden küresel ekonomiyi etkileyebileceğini değerlendirdi. ING ekonomisti James Smith, seçimlerin ardından Washington'da bölünmüş bir yönetim ortaya çıkmasının ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ı dış politika ve gümrük tarifeleri gibi yürütme yetkisinin daha geniş olduğu alanlara yöneltebileceğini belirtti. Demokratların Kongre'de çoğunluğu İran politikasını etkileyebilir ING'ye göre Demokratların Kongre'de çoğunluğu elde etmesi, Trump yönetiminin İran politikasında iki farklı sonuç doğurabilir. İç politikada yasama faaliyetlerinin zorlaşması, Trump'ın dış politikaya daha fazla ağırlık vermesine yol açabilir. Diğer taraftan Demokratların Kongre'deki etkisinin artması, İran savaşı ve bu savaşın finansmanına yönelik itirazları güçlendirebilir. ABD Başkan Yardımcısı JD Vance'in İran'a gönderdiği mektup diplomatik çözüm ihtimaline işaret ederken, bölgeye ilave ABD askeri kapasitesi gönderildiğine ilişkin haberler yeni saldırı olasılığını gündemde tutuyor. ING, çatışmalarda yeni bir tırmanış yaşanmaması halinde enerji fiyatlarında oluşan yüksek risk priminin bir bölümünün ortadan kalkabileceğini öngördü. Trump yönetiminden Avrupa'ya yeni tarife gelebilir ING, ABD'de federal bütçe açığının gayrisafi yurt içi hasılanın (GSYH) yaklaşık yüzde 6'sına ulaştığını ve Kongre'de bu açığı anlamlı ölçüde azaltmaya yönelik güçlü bir eğilim bulunmadığını belirtti. Banka, şubat ayında ikinci bir faiz artışının da gündeme gelebileceğini öngörüyor. items.titleTr: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say
items.summaryTr: Five officers from the Hamas-run police have been killed in Khan Younis and three people, including a child, killed in Gaza City, officials say.
items.articleText: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say - Published Israeli strikes in Gaza have killed at least eight people, including a child, according to hospitals, despite a year-old ceasefire. In Gaza City to the north, hospital officials said a missile attack hit a group of civilians next to Cairo School in the Al-Rimal neighbourhood, killing three people, including a four-year-old boy. In the southern city of Khan Younis, the Hamas-run ministry of interior said a drone attack targeted a group of police officers in the Al-Mawasi area, killing five, as they were carrying out their routine duties. The Israeli military said it had carried out two attacks on what it described as military operatives but has not yet provided evidence or further information. Outside Gaza City's Shifa Hospital, video showed a crowd of men gathered to pray next to two body bags and the tiny body of the child, which was wrapped in a white towel. "My son and his child were martyred. They were sitting in their tent, bothering no one, and nothing else was happening in the area when suddenly, a missile struck them, and they were martyred," Ali Oweis told AFP news agency. "There is no ceasefire; the war is ongoing, don't you see?" At Nasser hospital in Khan Younis, women despaired as body bags lay on the floor, video showed. The interior ministry named the five police officers killed, who were between the ages of 23 and 53, and called the attack a "horrific massacre". A ceasefire came into force in Gaza in October last year, but Israeli air strikes have continued almost every day. Since then, 1,580 people have been killed, according to Gaza's Hamas-run health ministry, whose figures are considered reliable by the UN. Israel says it is targeting Hamas, but often civilians are also killed. Meanwhile, a peace plan for Gaza, brokered by the Trump administration, has stalled. The ceasefire saw thousands of Palestinians held by Israel released in return for all of the 48 remaining hostages held in Gaza, and an agreement to end the war. The conflict was triggered by the Hamas-led attack on Israel on 7 October 2023, when about 1,200 people were killed and 251 taken hostage. Since the war began, 74,594 people have been killed in Gaza, according to the territory's health ministry. Additional reporting by Jacob Phillips Related topics - Published19 October

items.summary: Marta Shahbazi was an "inspiring, talented and passionate scientist", says the laboratory where she worked.

items.titleTr: University of Cambridge scientist among those who died in Spanish train crash
items.summaryTr: Marta Shahbazi was an "inspiring, talented and passionate scientist", says the laboratory where she worked.
items.articleText: Cambridge scientist dies in Spanish train crash - Published An award-winning University of Cambridge researcher died in the Spanish train disaster while on her way to collect a prize for scientific excellence. Dr Marta Shahbazi was travelling to an awards ceremony on Wednesday when the train she was on crashed into another near Urda, south of Madrid, killing 69 people. The mother of two was an affiliate associate professor leading a group of researchers at MRC Laboratory of Molecular Biology (LMB) in Cambridge and had earned several awards for work on human embryos and cell biology. In a statement, the LMB paid tribute to the "inspiring, talented and passionate scientist" and described her death as a "profound shock and a huge loss". The expert in cell biology ran the Shahbazi Laboratory at the LMB, based on the Cambridge Biomedical Campus. She had been announced as the winner of a Spanish Society for Developmental Biology award for her contributions to the study of early human development and was due to collect the award at a conference in El Rompido in Andalusia. The LMB said: "As a wife and mother of two young children, Marta wrote eloquently about balancing her family and career, serving as a much-admired role model for a 'mother scientist', a term she used to describe herself. "Marta was an inspiring, talented and passionate scientist whose research shed light on the earliest steps in the development of human embryos and how errors occur that lead to failed pregnancies," the LMB said. The institute said her death was "a profound shock and a huge loss for LMB". Her work had been recognised with "many awards and prizes", the laboratory added. Shahbazi is listed on the University of Cambridge website as a principal investigator at its Stem Cell Institute (CSCI). Institute director Prof Bertie Gottgens said its community was "shocked and deeply saddened" by her death. "Marta led her primary research group at the MRC Laboratory of Molecular Biology (LMB) alongside her roles as an affiliate principal investigator and affiliate assistant professor at the CSCI," he said. "Across both institutes, she was highly respected for her pioneering research on early human development and valued for her collaborative spirit. "Her creativity, passion, and generosity will be greatly missed." The news of her death was first confirmed in a social media post, external by the CiMUS, based in Santiago de Compostela where Shahbazi's aunt works. Shahbazi undertook her PhD at the Spanish National Cancer Research Centre, before joining the University of Cambridge as a post-doctoral fellow and then the LMB in 2020. The crash in Spain happened when a state-operated Renfe high-speed train smashed into the back of a stationary train operated by the Iryo company. It is one of the worst rail disasters in Europe's modern history, and Spain's worst crash since 2013. Three days of national mourning were declared in the country. More than 540 people were on board both trains. Get in touch Your Voice Follow Cambridgeshire news on BBC Sounds, Facebook, external, Instagram, external and X, external.

items.title: Thousands of jobs at Virgin Media O2 to be cut
items.summary: The broadband provider has not finalised the number of roles to be axed but it will likely be a sizeable chunk of its workforce, the BBC understands.

items.titleTr: Thousands of jobs at Virgin Media O2 to be cut
items.summaryTr: The broadband provider has not finalised the number of roles to be axed but it will likely be a sizeable chunk of its workforce, the BBC understands.
items.articleText: Thousands of jobs at Virgin Media O2 to be cut - Published Thousands of Virgin Media O2 staff face redundancy risk as the telecoms firm looks to save money in the face of billions of pounds of debt and tougher competition. The broadband provider has not finalised the number of roles to be cut but it is likely be a sizeable chunk of its 16,000 workforce, the BBC understands. VMO2 has billions of debt on its balance sheet and is tackling competition from both smaller providers as well as giants like BT, which has agreed a deal to acquire rival TalkTalk, a move which VMO2 has firmly opposed. VMO2 declined to comment. The Prospect union, which represents VMO2 staff, said the cuts were "disappointing and very unsettling". Deputy general secretary Noel McClean said it is "committed to supporting our members through what is a difficult time, as well as also working with employers to explore ways to mitigate the number of redundancies and ensure retraining and redeployment of staff affected". The majority of the affected staff will be in non-customer facing roles and a number of senior leadership changes are already under way, the BBC has been told. VMO2 is also expected to review its use of contractors and suppliers in conjunction with the job cuts that were first reported by Sky News. As of 30 June, VMO2's total debt stands at £27.2bn while it holds assets worth £45.9bn, according to the firm's latest accounts. Meanwhile, the company is dealing with fierce competition from cheaper "altnets" like Hyperoptic, Community Fibre, Gigaclear, and YouFibre. VMO2's had attempted to respond to this growing threat by buying altnet competitor Netomnia for £2bn via nexfibre, a joint venture owned by VMO2's owners. However, the Competition Markets Authority (CMA) has provisionally found competition concerns in the deal, external, with a final decision to come in December, sparking anger from VMO2. BT share price jump At the time, VMO2 called the BT takeover a "stitch-up", which allowed its rival "tighten its grip" over the market. BT said its deal provided "a safety net" for TalkTalk customers as their broadband provider faced collapse without the takeover. On Friday, BT's share price jumped 7% after the Financial Times reported VMO2 was close to agreeing a deal , external to use its rival's fibre broadband network. VMO2 was minded to go ahead with the plans after halting upgrades and expansion of its own infrastructure to ease concerns over its debt pile, the paper reported. The BBC has been told the deal is very close and that VMO2 is highly likely to announce it will stop all investment in fibre in its results on Tuesday. Additional reporting by Ben King - Published5 October

items.articleText: Galatasaray yönetiminde peş peşe istifa: İki isim görevini bıraktı - Galatasaray'da 27 Ekim'deki yönetim kurulu toplantısında yaşanan tartışmanın ardından iki yönetici istifa etti. - Sportif AŞ Başkan Vekili Abdullah Kavukcu ile İkinci Başkan Metin Öztürk, yönetim kurulu ve bağlı şirketlerdeki görevlerinden ayrıldıklarını açıkladı. Galatasaray Kulübü yönetiminde yaşanan tartışma istifaları beraberinde getirdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Yönetim Kurulu Üyesi ve Sportif AŞ Başkan Vekili Abdullah Kavukcu ile Kulüp İkinci Başkanı Metin Öztürk, görevlerinden ayrıldıklarını duyurdu. Abdullah Kavukcu, sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı açıklamada, 27 Ekim'deki yönetim kurulu toplantısının ardından Metin Öztürk ile arasında yaşanan sözlü tartışmanın özellikle sosyal medyada gerçek boyutlarından uzaklaştırıldığını belirtti. Tartışmanın kulübün hedeflerinin ve birlik beraberliğinin önüne geçmesini istemediğini ifade eden Kavukcu, Galatasaray'ın itibarının zarar görmemesi için yönetim kurulu üyeliğinden istifa etme kararı aldığını bildirdi. Kavukcu, Galatasaray'a bağlılığının herhangi bir görev veya unvanla sınırlı olmadığını vurgulayarak, kulübün başarısı için katkı sunmaya devam edeceğini kaydetti. Metin Öztürk de istifa etti Galatasaray Kulübü İkinci Başkanı Metin Öztürk de sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı açıklamayla yönetim kurulu ve kulübe bağlı şirketlerdeki görevlerinden istifa ettiğini duyurdu. 27 Ekim'deki yönetim kurulu toplantısında yaşananlara ilişkin açıklama yapan Öztürk, tartışmanın fiili saldırıya ve hayatını kaybeden annesine yönelik hakarete dönüştüğünü öne sürdü. items.titleTr: 15 yaş altına sosyal medya yasağı yürürlüğe girdi: Yaş doğrulamada e-Devlet şartı
items.summaryTr: Çocukların sosyal medya kullanımına yaş sınırı getiren yönetmelik Resmi Gazete'de yayımlanarak yürürlüğe girdi. 15 yaşını doldurmamış çocuklara sosyal medya hizmeti sunulamayacak, mevcut hesaplar için yaş doğrulaması 31 Mart 2027'ye kadar tamamlanacak.
items.articleText: 15 yaş altına sosyal medya yasağı yürürlüğe girdi: Yaş doğrulamada e-Devlet şartı Çocukların sosyal medya kullanımına yaş sınırı getiren yönetmelik Resmi Gazete'de yayımlanarak yürürlüğe girdi. 15 yaşını doldurmamış çocuklara sosyal medya hizmeti sunulamayacak, mevcut hesaplar için yaş doğrulaması 31 Mart 2027'ye kadar tamamlanacak. Aile ve Sosyal Hizmetler Bakanı Mahinur Özdemir Göktaş, çocukların sosyal medya kullanımına yönelik yeni yaş sınırlaması yönetmeliğinin yürürlüğe girdiğini duyurdu. Düzenlemeyle 15 yaşını doldurmamış çocukların sosyal medya platformlarında hesap açmasının önüne geçilirken, 15-18 yaş grubuna özel hizmet sunulması zorunlu hale geldi. Bakan Göktaş, NSosyal hesabından yaptığı açıklamada, yeni düzenlemenin çocukların dijital ortamda korunması açısından önemli bir adım olduğunu belirtti. Yönetmelik kapsamında sosyal medya platformları, 15 yaşını doldurmamış çocuklara hizmet sunamayacak. 15-18 yaş aralığındaki kullanıcılar için ise yaş grubuna özel, ayrıştırılmış hizmetler sağlanacak. Platformlar ayrıca kullanışlı ebeveyn kontrol araçları sunacak. Yaş doğrulamada e-Devlet zorunlu olacak Yeni açılacak sosyal medya hesaplarında yaş doğrulaması zorunlu tutulacak. Mevcut hesapların da 31 Mart 2027'ye kadar yaş doğrulama işlemini tamamlaması gerekecek. Bakan Göktaş, yaş doğrulama işlemlerinin yalnızca turkiye.gov.tr adresi ve resmi e-Devlet uygulaması üzerinden yapılabileceğini bildirdi. Bunun dışındaki internet siteleri ve uygulamalar üzerinden doğrulama yapılamayacak. Çocukların sosyal medya hesaplarına hangi kısıtlamalar gelecek? Bakanlığın paylaştığı bilgilere göre yeni düzenleme kapsamında çocuklara yönelik sosyal medya hizmetlerinde çeşitli özellikler sınırlandırılacak. Bu kapsamda: Çocuklara yalnızca takip ettikleri hesaplardan mesaj gönderilebilecek. Mesajlarda görüldü bilgisi gösterilmeyecek. Canlı yayın açılması engellenecek. Ekran görüntüsü alınamayacak. Hesap önerileri yapılamayacak. Kişiselleştirme ve kişiye özel reklam uygulanmayacak. Rehber eşleştirmesi yapılamayacak. Ebeveynlere hangi kontrol imkanları sunulacak? Yeni düzenlemeyle ebeveynlerin çocuklarının sosyal medya kullanımını takip etmesi ve sınırlandırması da hedefleniyor. Ebeveynler hesap ve özellik ayarlarını yönetebilecek; uygulama içi satın alma, kiralama ve ücretli üyelik işlemlerini kontrol edebilecek. Ayrıca harcama limitleri ve kullanım süreleri belirlenebilecek, konum paylaşımı mekanizmaları üzerinde kontrol sağlanabilecek. Sosyal medya platformlarına da yükümlülük getiriliyor Yeni yönetmelik yalnızca kullanıcılara yaş sınırı getirmekle kalmıyor, sosyal ağ sağlayıcılarına da çocukların korunmasına yönelik teknik ve idari sorumluluklar yüklüyor. Yaş doğrulama, ebeveyn kontrol araçları ve çocuklara özel hizmetlerin uygulanması platformların yerine getirmesi gereken yükümlülükler arasında yer alıyor.

items.summary: Borsa İstanbul Genel Müdür Yardımcısı Atila Türeli, Yönetim Kurulu kararıyla genel müdürlük görevine vekaleten atandı. Türeli, kurumda 2000 yılından bu yana farklı kademelerde görev yapıyor.

items.titleTr: Atila Türeli kimdir, kaç yaşında, nereli? Atila Türeli'nin hayatı ve kariyeri
items.summaryTr: Borsa İstanbul Genel Müdür Yardımcısı Atila Türeli, Yönetim Kurulu kararıyla genel müdürlük görevine vekaleten atandı. Türeli, kurumda 2000 yılından bu yana farklı kademelerde görev yapıyor.
items.articleText: Atila Türeli kimdir, kaç yaşında, nereli? Atila Türeli'nin hayatı ve kariyeri - 1970 yılında Konya'da doğan Atila Türeli Borsa İstanbul A.Ş. Genel Müdürlüğü görevine vekaleten getirildi. Türeli, kurumda 2000 yılından bu yana farklı kademelerde görev yaptı. Peki, Atila Türeli kimdir, kaç yaşında, nereli? İşte eğitimi, mesleki kariyeri ve hayatına ilişkin merak edilenler. Borsa İstanbul'da üst düzey yönetim değişikliği yaşandı. Borsa İstanbul A.Ş. Genel Müdür Yardımcısı Atila Türeli, Yönetim Kurulu kararıyla Genel Müdürlük görevine vekaleten getirildi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Peki, Atila Türeli kimdir, kaç yaşında, nereli ve hangi okullardan mezun oldu? İşte Atila Türeli'nin biyografisi... Atila Türeli kimdir? Atila Türeli 1970'de Konya Ereğli'de doğdu. İlkokulu Ereğli Cumhuriyet İlkokulu'nda, ortaokul ve liseyi Konya Anadolu Lisesi'nde tamamlayan Türeli, 1993'te İstanbul Üniversitesi Hukuk Fakültesi'nden mezun oldu. Bahçeşehir Üniversitesi Sosyal Bilimler Enstitüsünde Avrupa Birliği Kamu Hukuku ve Entegrasyon yüksek lisans programını 2008'de tamamladı. Avukatlık ruhsatını 1994'te alan Türeli, 2000 yılına kadar adli yargıda hakim olarak görev yaptı. Türeli, 2000 yılında İstanbul Menkul Kıymetler Borsası'nın (İMKB) açtığı sınavı kazanarak Hukuk Müşavirliğinde avukat olarak göreve başladı. Aynı bölümde 2000-2012 yılları arasında her kademede çalışan Türeli, 2012-2014'te üye işleri bölüm müdürü, 2014-2016'da uyum bölüm müdürü, 2016-2023 arasında ise başhukuk müşaviri olarak görev yaptı. Halen Türkiye Ürün İhtisas Borsası (TÜRİB) Yönetim Kurulu Üyesi ve İstanbul Tahkim Merkezi Genel Kurul Üyesi olan Türeli'nin çeşitli hukuk dallarında uzman arabuluculuk sertifikaları bulunuyor.

items.title: Hürmüz Boğazı için kritik temas: İran'dan yeni açıklama
items.summary: İran Dışişleri Bakanı Abbas Erakçi, Hürmüz Boğazı'na ilişkin iki günlük plan konusunda Katarlı arabulucularla yürütülen görüşmelerde henüz kesin bir sonuca ulaşılmadığını açıkladı. Erakçi, Tahran'ın hem diplomasiye hem de olası senaryolara hazır olduğunu söyledi.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Hürmüz Boğazı için kritik temas: İran'dan yeni açıklama
items.summaryTr: İran Dışişleri Bakanı Abbas Erakçi, Hürmüz Boğazı'na ilişkin iki günlük plan konusunda Katarlı arabulucularla yürütülen görüşmelerde henüz kesin bir sonuca ulaşılmadığını açıkladı. Erakçi, Tahran'ın hem diplomasiye hem de olası senaryolara hazır olduğunu söyledi.
items.articleText: Hürmüz Boğazı için kritik temas: İran'dan yeni açıklama - İran Dışişleri Bakanı Abbas Erakçi, Hürmüz Boğazı'na ilişkin iki günlük plan konusunda Katarlı arabulucularla yürütülen görüşmelerde henüz kesin bir sonuca ulaşılmadığını açıkladı. - Erakçi, Tahran'ın hem diplomasiye hem de olası senaryolara hazır olduğunu söyledi. İran ile ABD arasındaki gerilimin gölgesinde Hürmüz Boğazı'na ilişkin diplomatik temaslar sürüyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İran Dışişleri Bakanı Abbas Erakçi, Katar aracılığıyla yürütülen görüşmelerde henüz uzlaşmaya varılamadığını belirtti. İran resmi haber ajansı IRNA'ya göre Erakçi, Meclis Ulusal Güvenlik ve Dış Politika Komisyonu toplantısının ardından yaptığı açıklamada, İran heyetinin Katar ziyaretini değerlendirdi. Görüşmelerin devam ettiğini belirten Erakçi, kesin bir sonuca ulaşılmasının karşı tarafın İran'ın sorularına vereceği yanıtlara bağlı olduğunu söyledi. Ziyaretin Dışişleri Bakan Yardımcısı düzeyinde gerçekleştirildiğini aktaran Erakçi, temasların son haftalarda Tahran'da bulunan Katarlı arabulucularla istişareleri sürdürmek amacı taşıdığını kaydetti. ABD ile doğrudan müzakere planı yok Erakçi, Katar ziyaretinde ABD tarafıyla doğrudan müzakere yapılmasının planlanmadığını vurguladı. Hürmüz Boğazı'na ilişkin iki günlük plan üzerindeki görüşmelerin arabulucular aracılığıyla devam ettiğini ifade etti. Diplomatik çabaları sürdürdüklerini belirten Erakçi, karşı tarafın da diplomasiye öncelik vermesini beklediklerini dile getirdi. "İran tüm senaryolara hazır" İran'ın olası tüm senaryolara hazırlıklı olduğunu söyleyen Erakçi, ülke lideri Mücteba Hamaney'in üst düzey askeri komutanlara verdiği talimatların İran'ın kararlılığını ortaya koyduğunu savundu. İran Silahlı Kuvvetlerinin görevlerinin net olduğunu belirten Erakçi, önceki iki savaştan edinilen tecrübeler sayesinde ordunun eskisinden daha güçlü olduğunu ileri sürdü. Erakçi, İran'ın savunma ve diplomasi süreçlerini eş zamanlı yürütmeye hazır olduğunu, ABD'nin hangi yolu seçeceğinin ise kendi yaklaşımına bağlı bulunduğunu söyledi. Hürmüz Boğazı neden önemli? Hürmüz Boğazı, Basra Körfezi'ni Umman Körfezi ve Arap Denizi'ne bağlayan, küresel enerji ticaretinin en kritik geçiş noktalarından biri olarak kabul ediliyor. Dünya petrol tüketiminin yaklaşık beşte birine karşılık gelen petrol ve petrol ürünleri bu güzergâhtan taşınıyor. Boğazdaki olası bir aksama, petrol fiyatları ve küresel enerji arzı üzerinde doğrudan etkili olabiliyor.

İran ile ABD arasındaki gerilimin gölgesinde Hürmüz Boğazı'na ilişkin diplomatik temaslar sürüyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İran Dışişleri Bakanı Abbas Erakçi, Katar aracılığıyla yürütülen görüşmelerde henüz uzlaşmaya varılamadığını belirtti. İran resmi haber ajansı IRNA'ya göre Erakçi, Meclis Ulusal Güvenlik ve Dış Politika Komisyonu toplantısının ardından yaptığı açıklamada, İran heyetinin Katar ziyaretini değerlendirdi. Görüşmelerin devam ettiğini belirten Erakçi, kesin bir sonuca ulaşılmasının karşı tarafın İran'ın sorularına vereceği yanıtlara bağlı olduğunu söyledi. Ziyaretin Dışişleri Bakan Yardımcısı düzeyinde gerçekleştirildiğini aktaran Erakçi, temasların son haftalarda Tahran'da bulunan Katarlı arabulucularla istişareleri sürdürmek amacı taşıdığını kaydetti. ABD ile doğrudan müzakere planı yok Erakçi, Katar ziyaretinde ABD tarafıyla doğrudan müzakere yapılmasının planlanmadığını vurguladı. Hürmüz Boğazı'na ilişkin iki günlük plan üzerindeki görüşmelerin arabulucular aracılığıyla devam ettiğini ifade etti. Diplomatik çabaları sürdürdüklerini belirten Erakçi, karşı tarafın da diplomasiye öncelik vermesini beklediklerini dile getirdi. "İran tüm senaryolara hazır" İran'ın olası tüm senaryolara hazırlıklı olduğunu söyleyen Erakçi, ülke lideri Mücteba Hamaney'in üst düzey askeri komutanlara verdiği talimatların İran'ın kararlılığını ortaya koyduğunu savundu. İran Silahlı Kuvvetlerinin görevlerinin net olduğunu belirten Erakçi, önceki iki savaştan edinilen tecrübeler sayesinde ordunun eskisinden daha güçlü olduğunu ileri sürdü. Erakçi, İran'ın savunma ve diplomasi süreçlerini eş zamanlı yürütmeye hazır olduğunu, ABD'nin hangi yolu seçeceğinin ise kendi yaklaşımına bağlı bulunduğunu söyledi. Hürmüz Boğazı neden önemli? Hürmüz Boğazı, Basra Körfezi'ni Umman Körfezi ve Arap Denizi'ne bağlayan, küresel enerji ticaretinin en kritik geçiş noktalarından biri olarak kabul ediliyor. Dünya petrol tüketiminin yaklaşık beşte birine karşılık gelen petrol ve petrol ürünleri bu güzergâhtan taşınıyor. Boğazdaki olası bir aksama, petrol fiyatları ve küresel enerji arzı üzerinde doğrudan etkili olabiliyor.

items.titleTr: Borsa İstanbul Genel Müdürlüğü görevine vekaleten Atila Türeli getirildi
items.summaryTr: Borsa İstanbul A.Ş. Genel Müdür Yardımcısı Atila Türeli, Yönetim Kurulu kararıyla Genel Müdürlük görevine vekaleten getirildi.
items.articleText: Borsa İstanbul Genel Müdürlüğü görevine vekaleten Atila Türeli getirildi - Borsa İstanbul Genel Müdürü Korkmaz Enes Ergun’un fon soruşturması kapsamında gözaltına alınmasının ardından yönetimde görev değişikliğine gidildi. - Genel Müdür Yardımcısı Atila Türeli, yönetim kurulu kararıyla genel müdürlük görevine vekâleten atandı. Borsa İstanbuldan yapılan açıklamaya göre, bugün gerçekleştirilen Yönetim Kurulu Toplantısı'nda alınan karar doğrultusunda, Borsa İstanbul AŞ Genel Müdürlüğü görevine vekaleten Atila Türeli getirildi. Enes Ergun gözaltına alınmıştı CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Borsa İstanbul Genel Müdürü Korkmaz Enes Ergun dün gözaltına alındı. İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı, Ergun'un fon soruşturması kapsamında "suç işlemek amacıyla kurulan örgüte üye olma" ve "rüşvet" suçlamalarıyla gözaltına alındığını açıkladı. Korkmaz Enes Ergun, 26 Mart 2021 tarihinden itibaren Borsa İstanbul'da genel müdürlük görevini yürütüyordu. Atilla Türeli kimdir? Atila Türeli 1970'de Konya Ereğli'de doğdu. İlkokulu Ereğli Cumhuriyet İlkokulunda, ortaokul ve liseyi Konya Anadolu Lisesinde tamamlayan Türeli, 1993'te İstanbul Üniversitesi Hukuk Fakültesinden mezun oldu. Bahçeşehir Üniversitesi Sosyal Bilimler Enstitüsünde Avrupa Birliği Kamu Hukuku ve Entegrasyon yüksek lisans programını 2008'de tamamladı. Avukatlık ruhsatını 1994'te alan Türeli, 2000 yılına kadar adli yargıda hakim olarak görev yaptı. Türeli, 2000 yılında İstanbul Menkul Kıymetler Borsasının (İMKB) açtığı sınavı kazanarak Hukuk Müşavirliğinde avukat olarak göreve başladı. Aynı bölümde 2000-2012 yılları arasında her kademede çalışan Türeli, 2012-2014'te üye işleri bölüm müdürü, 2014-2016'da uyum bölüm müdürü, 2016-2023 arasında ise başhukuk müşaviri olarak görev yaptı. Halen Türkiye Ürün İhtisas Borsası (TÜRİB) Yönetim Kurulu Üyesi ve İstanbul Tahkim Merkezi Genel Kurul Üyesi olan Türeli'nin çeşitli hukuk dallarında uzman arabuluculuk sertifikaları bulunuyor.

items.summaryTr: ABD'de 3 Kasım'da yapılacak Kongre ara seçimleri öncesinde anketler, hem Temsilciler Meclisi hem de Senatoda Demokratların avantajlı olduğunu gösteriyor. Ancak başa baş yarışın sürdüğü eyalet ve seçim bölgeleri, Kongre'deki çoğunluğun hangi partide olacağını belirleyebilir.
items.articleText: ABD ara seçimlerinde kritik eşik: Senato ve Temsilciler Meclisi için yarış kızıştı - ABD'de 3 Kasım'da yapılacak Kongre ara seçimleri öncesinde anketler, hem Temsilciler Meclisi hem de Senatoda Demokratların avantajlı olduğunu gösteriyor. Ancak başa baş yarışın sürdüğü eyalet ve seçim bölgeleri, Kongre'deki çoğunluğun hangi partide olacağını belirleyebilir. ABD'de Kongre ara seçimleri yaklaşırken siyasi dengelerin değişebileceğine yönelik beklentiler güçleniyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle 3 Kasım'da gerçekleştirilecek seçimlerde 435 sandalyeli Temsilciler Meclisi'nin tamamı ve 100 sandalyeli Senatonun 35 sandalyesi için seçmenler sandık başına gidecek. Ülke genelinde yapılan anketlerin ortalaması, Demokratların her iki kanatta da Cumhuriyetçilere karşı avantaj yakaladığını ortaya koyuyor. Ancak özellikle başa baş yarışın sürdüğü seçim bölgelerinde sonuçların son ana kadar değişebileceği değerlendiriliyor. Senatoda Demokratlar önde Real Clear Politics (RCP) tarafından derlenen anket ortalamalarına göre, Senatoda Demokratların 47, Cumhuriyetçilerin ise 45 sandalye kazanması bekleniyor. Sekiz eyaletteki yarışta ise adaylar arasındaki rekabet sürüyor. Başa baş yarışın yaşandığı sekiz sandalyenin yedisinde Cumhuriyetçiler, birinde ise Demokratlar önde görünüyor. Cumhuriyetçilerin bu sekiz sandalyeden en az beşini kazanması halinde Senatoda 50 sandalyeye ulaşması bekleniyor. Bu durumda oluşabilecek 50-50 eşitlikte Başkan Yardımcısı JD Vance'in eşitlik bozma oyu Cumhuriyetçilere çoğunluğu sağlayabilir. ABD yasalarına göre Senato Başkanı görevini de yürüten başkan yardımcısı, oyların eşit çıkması halinde belirleyici oy kullanabiliyor. Temsilciler Meclisi'nde de Demokratlar avantajlı 435 sandalyenin tamamının yenileneceği Temsilciler Meclisi'nde çoğunluğu elde etmek için 218 sandalyeye ulaşmak gerekiyor. RCP'nin anket ortalamalarına göre Demokratların 227, Cumhuriyetçilerin ise 182 sandalye kazanması öngörülüyor. Bununla birlikte 26 sandalye için iki parti arasındaki yarışın başa baş devam ettiği belirtiliyor. Mevcut tahminler, Demokratların Temsilciler Meclisi'nde çoğunluğu yeniden kazanma ihtimalinin daha yüksek olduğuna işaret ediyor. Kongre'de mevcut sandalye dağılımı ABD Kongresinin mevcut yapısında Senatoda Cumhuriyetçilerin 53, Demokratların 45 sandalyesi bulunuyor. İki bağımsız senatör ise birçok konuda Demokratlarla birlikte hareket ediyor. Temsilciler Meclisinde Cumhuriyetçilerin 218, Demokratların 214 sandalyesi bulunurken bir sandalye bağımsız üyeye ait. İki sandalye ise boş durumda. Ara seçimler neden önemli? ABD'de ara seçimler, başkanlık seçimlerinin yapıldığı dönemlerin ortasında, dört yıllık başkanlık süresinin ikinci yılında düzenleniyor. Seçimler, başkanın görev süresinin kalan bölümünde Kongre üzerindeki siyasi kontrolünü doğrudan etkiliyor. Kongre'nin iki kanadında çoğunluğu kaybeden başkanın yasa çıkarma ve ekonomi politikalarını hayata geçirme süreci zorlaşabiliyor.

items.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto: The FBI said that North Korea was responsible for the theft of about $6.3 billion in digital assets from cryptocurrency exchange Binance. Soon after the $6.3 billion hack of Binance, some political and administration figures began offering their opinions with a US election approaching on Nov. 3 and voting already having begun in many locations. Coinbase led a selloff in crypto-linked stocks following Binance’s record-breaking $6.3 billion hack. FBI blames North Korea for record $6.3B Binance hack The FBI said that the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (North Korea) was responsible for the theft of about $6.3 billion in digital assets from cryptocurrency exchange Binance on Thursday. The FBI said on Saturday in a news release that it refers to this specific North Korean malicious cyber activity as “TraderTraitor,” which it has most recently observed converting stolen assets mostly into Ether (ETH). It expects these assets to be further converted, using DeFi and instant swap services, as the hackers move to more advanced laundering stages. The FBI urged private sector entities including THORNode operators, RPC node operators, instant exchanges, DeFi services, blockchain analytics firms and other digital asset service providers to block transactions with or derived from addresses TraderTraitor actors are using to launder these stolen assets. A full list of addresses is provided on the news release. Binance hack sparks pre-election political clashes Soon after the $6.3 billion hack of Binance, the biggest in crypto history, some political and administration figures began offering their opinions with a US election approaching on Nov. 3 and voting already having begun in many locations. President Donald Trump was asked at a news conference on Friday about the hack of Binance. “We don’t know. We’re looking at that, the hack with Binance. They’re saying they’re going to get it back, they’re saying they’re guaranteeing it,” he replied. The crypto exchange said in a post on X late Friday that it would cover any losses. “We want to be clear about our commitment: Binance will absorb the financial impact of these stolen funds, not our users.” It added that about $3 billion of the stolen funds had already been frozen in various locations. On Saturday, Binance said it had already covered 90% of the impacted amount of the hacked loss. It was not clear whether there was any immediate political advantage to be gained from the hack, which was widely attributed to a North Korean group, but Republican and Democratic sides began staking out positions almost immediately. Coinbase leads crypto stock selloff following $6.3 billion Binance hack Shares of publicly traded cryptocurrency companies fell sharply Friday, with Coinbase dropping more than 13% a day after reporting a decline in third-quarter revenue, as the industry dealt with Binance’s $6.3 billion hack. Other crypto-linked stocks also declined, with stablecoin issuer Circle Internet Group (CRCL) falling more than 9% and Bitcoin treasury company Strategy (MSTR) dropping about 8%, according to Yahoo Finance data at the time of writing. The selloff also hit Bitcoin mining and data center operator IREN (IREN), whose shares fell more than 10%, and blockchain-based financial services company Figure Technology Solutions (FIGR), which dropped about 9%. The declines followed Thursday’s disclosure of the Binance breach. The exchange confirmed Friday that hackers stole about $6.3 billion in the largest cryptocurrency theft on record.

Binance hack sparks pre-election political clashes Soon after the $6.3 billion hack of Binance, the biggest in crypto history, some political and administration figures began offering their opinions with a US election approaching on Nov. 3 and voting already having begun in many locations. President Donald Trump was asked at a news conference on Friday about the hack of Binance. “We don’t know. We’re looking at that, the hack with Binance. They’re saying they’re going to get it back, they’re saying they’re guaranteeing it,” he replied. It was not clear whether there was any immediate political advantage to be gained from the hack, which was widely attributed to a North Korean group, but Republican and Democratic sides began staking out positions almost immediately. The selloff also hit Bitcoin mining and data center operator IREN (IREN), whose shares fell more than 10%, and blockchain-based financial services company Figure Technology Solutions (FIGR), which dropped about 9%. items.articleText: DeepSeek developing AI agent requiring less human input: Report The proposal comes amid intense competition among AI developers, including US companies Anthropic and OpenAI, the SCMP said. Chinese artificial intelligence company DeepSeek has revealed a design to increase the autonomy of AI coding assistants so they can perform multiple tasks with less human intervention. The aim is to reduce human input in coordinating and monitoring multiple AI agents, according to a paper published by the company’s DeepSeek Harness team and reported by Singapore’s South China Morning Post on Sunday. Managing multiple agents demands human attention, the team said, noting that “single-task limits depend on model capabilities, while multitask limits depend on human attention.” The DeepSeek paper said a person can oversee only three to five active AI agent sessions simultaneously. Its proposed system would distribute tasks among agents and coordinate their work, leaving humans free to review results and make decisions. The proposal comes amid intense competition among AI developers, including US companies Anthropic and OpenAI, according to the SCMP. Cointelegraph reported last October that Chinese artificial intelligence models were outperforming US counterparts in cryptocurrency trading, according to data from blockchain analytics platform CoinGlass. AI chatbot DeepSeek led a crypto trading experiment, being the only AI model to generate a positive unrealized return of 9.1%. The results surprised crypto traders, given that DeepSeek was developed at a fraction of the cost of its US rivals. Magazine: New DeepSeek ban in US, Swiss-Asia crypto ties deepen: Asia Express

items.titleTr: Crypto firm Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3bn hack
items.summaryTr: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) says North Korea was responsible for the hack.
items.articleText: Crypto firm Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3bn hack - Published Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, says it has covered 90% of the $6.3bn (£4.7bn) assets stolen in a hack on Thursday. The remaining 10% may take longer to source in the required amounts, the company added. Binance has consistently pledged to cover 100% of the losses from what is suspected to be crypto's biggest hack on record and said it has set aside more than $6.34bn in company funds to do so. "Binance will absorb the financial impact of these stolen funds, not our users," the company said in a statement on Saturday. In an update on Sunday, Binance said withdrawals had been restored on several of its networks, after they were suspended following the hack. It previously said withdrawals would be resumed in phases. The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) said on Saturday that North Korea was responsible for the attack. The FBI said it had observed hackers converting stolen assets into a type of cryptocurrency called Ethereum and that it is expected that the assets will then be converted again using decentralised finance and instant swap services. Two analytics firms previously told the BBC they had robust intelligence pointing to North Korean state-backed hacking unit the Lazarus Group, also known as TraderTraitor - which was specifically named by the FBI - as the likely culprits. Speaking to reporters on Saturday night, US President Donald Trump said, external the US is still unsure who the culprits are. "We're learning about it. We don't know if it's North Korea - but if it is, we'll talk to North Korea about it," he said. Binance said it had replenished the stolen assets using various funds and its own corporate treasury. All holdings of the cryptocurrencies bitcoin, Ethereum and Tether are covered, along with seven other widely-traded crypto assets, the company said. The hack is believed to be the largest in history, eclipsing the record of a $1.5bn heist on the Bybit exchange in 2025 - for which the FBI also said North Korea was responsible. North Korea has always denied involvement in these attacks. Binance's initial investigation suggested an engineer's laptop was compromised, which allowed access to unauthorised withdrawals, but a later update said they had uncovered "additional points of breach". Richard Teng, Binance's co-chief executive officer, said the hack was carried out by more than one person, and the hackers used sophisticated methods to hide their tracks, such as a "self-destruct mechanism". On Friday, the company said it had frozen around $3bn of stolen assets after working with law enforcement, intelligence firms and partners. The investigation is ongoing, it added. The US Secret Service said on Friday it is "working around the clock" with private sector partners "to identify, freeze, trace, and recover funds" stolen from Binance. Binance, founded in China in 2017, lets users buy, sell and trade digital assets - it is estimated to have hundreds of millions of users worldwide. Crypto is a digital asset, which doesn't exist physically and is instead accessed via digital wallets or computers. Related topics - Published2 days ago

items.summary: The protests in cities across Germany - including Berlin, Hamburg and Frankfurt - came on the same day hundreds of thousands also protested in France.

items.titleTr: Shops looted as German cost-of-living protests turn violent
items.summaryTr: The protests in cities across Germany - including Berlin, Hamburg and Frankfurt - came on the same day hundreds of thousands also protested in France.
items.articleText: Shops looted as German cost-of-living protests turn violent - Published Rioters looted shops in central Frankfurt late on Saturday as clashes erupted in German cities over the cost of living. Besides Frankfurt - Germany's financial hub - there were incidents of violence in Berlin, Cologne and Hamburg, with police saying they used water cannon to disperse protesters who were targeting emergency workers with fireworks, stones and bottles. Thousands joined largely peaceful demonstrations earlier in the day. They were organised by the campaign group Gen Z regelt - meaning "Gen Z takes charge" - to protest against underfunding in schools, the high cost of living, public spending cuts and military service. The unrest in Germany follows similar youth-led mass protests in France, where more than 320,000 people also demonstrated on Saturday. On Sunday, Germany's Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt told Bild newspaper that overnight police had prevented "violence like that seen in Paris" in recent weeks and called for "harsh punishments" for rioters and looters. Overnight, a large section of Frankfurt's main shopping street was closed off by police. A police spokesperson said many arrests were made in the city. Authorities in Frankfurt, Munich and Berlin reported as many as 18,000 protesters, roughly half of what the organisers had estimated on their website. German media say tens of thousands protested in German cities on Saturday. Gen Z regelt spokesperson Lina Friedrich said the demonstrations were "to fight for peace and freedom, rather than for war and coercion". She said: "What matters most to us is better support for the health and education systems. We are against compulsory military service and we are in favour of a fairer distribution of the burden." - Europe's youth is on the march - but does anything actually unite them? - Published3 days ago On Saturday night Frankfurt police said "violent riots" were occurring in the city centre and that special police units had been deployed. The windows of several shops had been smashed and molotov cocktails were thrown at emergency services, police said. Officials said the windows of a gun shop were smashed and that they had seized two weapons after arresting a suspect. People also broke into other shops, stealing items like trainers. Roman Poseck, interior minister of Hesse state, of which Frankfurt is the biggest city, said that "around 100 clearly identified left-wing extremists" had infiltrated the protest in the city. He added that it was "shameful" how the protests had ended. "We all have those images from France in our minds - looting, burning houses, burning police vehicles, and attacks on police officers... France must not be held up as a model in this regard." Police said the situation calmed down overnight into Sunday in the city. Similar instances took place in other German cities, following largely peaceful demonstrations. In Cologne, police said officers were attacked near the main train station, with bottles thrown and a bicycle launched. Cologne's police chief Johannes Hermanns said it was "deeply saddening that young people who wanted to peacefully demonstrate for their future were infiltrated today by extremists who had nothing but violence in mind". A smaller demonstration in the evening in Berlin - following larger protests in the day - resulted in 27 police officers being injured, and up to 56 people temporarily detained, Berlin police said. In Hamburg, people dressed in black set off fireworks and set barricades on fire, with public broadcaster NDR reporting that 120 people were arrested. The protests in Germany took place on the same day as other large-scale demonstrations in Europe. In France, more than 320,000 people took part in a third consecutive weekend of largely peaceful protests in cities across the country, demanding action on the high cost of living and poor public services, especially in the education sector. Thousands of police officers were deployed across the country, and officers fired tear gas at demonstrators in some cities. There were more than 770 arrests across France during the demonstrations on Saturday, roughly half as many as the previous week's protests, the French interior ministry said. French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said a police officer had been injured by a molotov cocktail and French prosecutors later launched an attempted murder probe. Police in Paris said several hundred rioters had attacked security forces with projectiles. French protest organisers, the Gilet Jaune, or Yellow Vests, have said dozens of protesters have been seriously injured during recent demonstrations across the country, with many hurt by "grenades". France suspended the use of one type of stun grenade while policing student protests in early October after a 15-year-old's hand was blown off, but French newspaper Le Monde has reported, external that police have continued to use a different model in subsequent protests. Protests also took place in Italy, with some clashes between police and demonstrators in Rome and Turin. In Portugal, police moved to clear a new tent camp that had been assembled after thousands marched to protest against a rental bill that they argue could worsen a housing crisis in the country, where house prices have more than doubled over the past decade. Mostly young protesters have recently taken to the streets in a swathe of European nations: France, Belgium, Ireland, Spain, Portugal, Italy, Greece, Serbia and Albania. While the specific demands vary from country to country, the protesters have largely focused on cost-of-living issues, such as access to housing, the quality of education and cuts to public services. items.summaryTr: The crypto exchange said it has begun phased withdrawals after the record hack the FBI has blamed on North Korea.
items.articleText: Binance says phase one of withdrawals opens after $6.3B hack The crypto exchange said it has begun phased withdrawals after the record hack the FBI has blamed on North Korea. Binance said it has reopened its Bitcoin network in phase one of resuming withdrawals after a major hack of about $6.3 billion in funds. The crypto exchange had suspended user withdrawals after the attack on Thursday, which the FBI blamed on North Korean operatives. “First batch network now opened in phase one of withdrawals is $BTC bitcoin network,” Binance said on X. In an earlier X announcement on Sunday, Binance had said it would roll out withdrawal services in phases, which will be progressively available. Updates will be available on its official X channel, it added. “We are taking a phased approach by prioritizing tokens based on the past week data of user demand, so that each network and asset pair can be restored carefully, with stability and security checks completed before access is reopened,” Binance said. Users should check the withdrawal page for their selected asset and network, or visit the Binance network status page to confirm availability, the company said. During the phased rollout, it is expected that there will be some congestion, longer processing times and even temporary delays, Binance said, so if a withdrawal is not successful, users should try again after a short while. Cointelegraph reported on Saturday that Binance said it had replenished 90% of the assets stolen in the hack, up from 80% a day earlier, and remained on track to resume withdrawals Sunday. Magazine: Binance hackers raced to move billions before it could be frozen

items.titleTr: FBI blames North Korea for record $6.3B Binance hack
items.summaryTr: US agency seeks private-sector help to block further money-laundering of stolen digital assets.
items.articleText: FBI blames North Korea for record $6.3B Binance hack US agency seeks private-sector help to block further money-laundering of stolen digital assets. The FBI said that the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (North Korea) was responsible for the theft of about $6.3 billion in digital assets from cryptocurrency exchange Binance on Thursday. The FBI said on Saturday in a news release that it refers to this specific North Korean malicious cyber activity as “TraderTraitor,” which it has most recently observed converting stolen assets mostly into Ether (ETH). It expects these assets to be further converted, using DeFi and instant swap services, as the hackers move to more advanced laundering stages. The FBI urged private sector entities including THORNode operators, RPC node operators, instant exchanges, DeFi services, blockchain analytics firms and other digital asset service providers to block transactions with or derived from addresses TraderTraitor actors are using to launder these stolen assets. A full list of addresses is provided on the news release. Cointelegraph reported earlier this year that North Korea-linked hackers stole about 60% of the value lost to crypto hacks in 2025, with proceeds used to help fund the regime’s nuclear and ballistic missile programs, highlighting a growing reliance on digital assets to generate hard currency. North Korean defense spending supplemented Related: Crypto losses from North Korea hackers in 2025 rose 51% YoY: Report Those findings came from a CertiK report that attributed more than $2 billion of an estimated $3.4 billion in 2025 crypto security losses to groups tied North Korea, across 79 of 656 incidents documented that year. While North Korea does not publish credible budget data, according to independent research organization MilitarySpend, mid-range consensus places its actual annual defense spending at as much as $6 billion, using purchasing-power-adjusted GDP estimates, though this figure is uncertain. MilitarySpend adds that revenue from Russia arms transfers — estimated at as much as $5 billion in munitions exported to Russia from 2022-2025 per South Korean intelligence — supplements domestic weapons programs, as does cryptocurrency theft, which provides additional off-budget financing for WMD development. As Cointelegraph reported, between 2016 and early 2026, North Korea-linked actors stole an estimated $6.75 billion in cryptocurrency across 263 documented incidents, according to CertiK, citing findings by independent onchain researcher Taylor Monahan. CertiK’s analysis concluded that North Korea has industrialized crypto theft into a core state revenue mechanism. Magazine: Binance hackers raced to move billions before it could be frozen

While North Korea does not publish credible budget data, according to independent research organization MilitarySpend, mid-range consensus places its actual annual defense spending at as much as $6 billion, using purchasing-power-adjusted GDP estimates, though this figure is uncertain. MilitarySpend adds that revenue from Russia arms transfers — estimated at as much as $5 billion in munitions exported to Russia from 2022-2025 per South Korean intelligence — supplements domestic weapons programs, as does cryptocurrency theft, which provides additional off-budget financing for WMD development. As Cointelegraph reported, between 2016 and early 2026, North Korea-linked actors stole an estimated $6.75 billion in cryptocurrency across 263 documented incidents, according to CertiK, citing findings by independent onchain researcher Taylor Monahan. CertiK’s analysis concluded that North Korea has industrialized crypto theft into a core state revenue mechanism. Magazine: Binance hackers raced to move billions before it could be frozen

items.title: Energy bills help 'doesn't go far enough'
items.summary: Families in the West Midlands say they are worried about paying winter energy bills.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Energy bills help 'doesn't go far enough'
items.summaryTr: Families in the West Midlands say they are worried about paying winter energy bills.
items.articleText: Energy bills help 'doesn't go far enough' - Published Households in the West Midlands said they want to see the government revisit energy bills in the wake of the Budget - amid concerns the help being offered won't go far enough. Chancellor John Healey announced a £100 'household energy payment', and a future plan to remove gas standing charges, as part of a wider package to address the cost of living. Families in the region told the BBC they were "grateful" for the assistance, but were concerned about their finances over the winter. Kelly Birkett, a personal accountant from Redditch, said: "The £100 is good, but it's not great. It just gets absorbed into everything else families have to pay for, just to get by." Birkett, a married mum-of-two, said her family was already considering what to cut back on in the wake of the Budget. "I know I sound a little but ungrateful for the £100, and I don't want to be. I'm certainly not ungrateful," she said. "But in reality we're no better off. With the temperatures dropping we know the heating will have to be on, the children can't be cold. "We'll dig deep to make sure we're a little more conservative when it comes to the heating, but for sure it's something most families will be worried about (the winter.)" Mark Sumner, a coach driver from Alcester, said him and his wife sold their previous home partly to clear old debts that had accrued from bills including energy. He told the BBC they had fallen into "energy debt" and were concerned about this coming winter. "We know our bill will go up again, you're just dreading it each time the increase comes around, as to how much it will be," he said. "I very rarely take our children out for anything to eat anymore, and we're very careful about what we spend at the shops. "What the government has announced is helpful. I don't want to be ungrateful so I will say it's helpful for us, but it probably only covers one month (of bills). "So it's a slight help, but it's not enough." 'We are being fair to families' The government said "millions of families" would benefit from the measures announced in the Budget, including freezing fuel duty, the 3.9% minimum wage increase and scrapping plans to reduce the £20,000 tax-free limit on ISAs. Chancellor John Healey said the energy announcement was "just a small part" of what the government was doing to help families. "Conflict in the Middle East and Europe is hitting families here at home through higher everyday costs," he said. "We can't control global events, but we can act where we can make a difference." There is no definitive date for scrapping the standing charge on gas, but the Treasury has committed to doing it either in 2027 or "as soon as possible after". The VAT cut on electricity bills, which was due to end in April, will be extended to July next year. items.title: Diwali hampers to bring hope to families in need
items.summary: The Diwali Basket Brigade volunteers want to help vulnerable households with rising food prices.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Diwali hampers to bring hope to families in need
items.summaryTr: The Diwali Basket Brigade volunteers want to help vulnerable households with rising food prices.
items.articleText: Diwali hampers to bring hope to families in need - Published Hundreds of volunteers have packed food parcels to distribute to people across Birmingham struggling with the rising cost of living. About 300 people turned up to the Diwali Basket Brigade event at the RSRS Centre in Hockley, which was organised by The Diwali Foundation. It is the ninth time the charity has brought community volunteers from a variety of backgrounds together to make hampers in the build up to the religious festival. Deepak Parekh, founder of the initiative, said: "[The] cost of living crisis hasn't gone away... but Diwali is a celebration of light over darkness, and this is our little way of bringing some light and some hope into the families that need it most." The Diwali Foundation, who are based in Herefordshire, said that more than 12% of UK households are experiencing food poverty. It works with about forty different food banks and charities to reach vulnerable households. To date, the charity said it has provided around 23,470 food hampers to those in need. Volunteer Clare Hannah said, while packing bags: "You're thinking about, 'oh I wonder what they're going to make with this'. And the fact that this is all that they've got, for some people." Parcels were taken from Hockley to residents living in homes provided by Walsall Housing Group (whg). Faye Shanahan from whg said: "It's really tough out there. Our customers are having a really hard time. The cost of living is not easing. "Events like this today are really, really fantastic. It makes an absolutely fantastic difference to our customers." Resident John Whiting, who turned 80 on Saturday, described his parcel as "unbelievable". "There are a lot of people out there that've got nothing," he added. "The food will be tremendous, thank you." A London event was also held on Saturday, with similar events in Manchester and Leicester planned for Sunday. Organisers have set a target of providing 6,000 food hampers this year, which would top a 2025 record when more than 80,000 meals were provided. items.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
items.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

items.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
items.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

items.title: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
items.articleText: Release Number 9316-26 CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig announced the CFTC’s plan to increase the publication frequency of the Commitments of Traders Report (COT Report) from once to twice a week by the end of 2026. Data from Monday will be published on Wednesday, and data from Wednesday will be published on Friday. Both reports will be released at 3:30 p.m. ET on their respective publication days. Under the enhanced publication schedule, the reports’ latency will decrease from three days to two days. The change follows the Commission’s recent Request for Comment and reflects its commitment to providing market participants with more timely information about trading positions and activity in agricultural markets. The CFTC’s Division of Data is leading the effort to operationalize the expanded publication schedule through modernization and automation while maintaining accuracy. “COT Reports have been an important source of transparency for decades. Following feedback from the agricultural community, I’m pleased to announce the CFTC will be rolling out COT Reports twice a week to ensure this information stream is as useful as possible,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. -CFTC-

items.title: CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction
items.articleText: Release Number 9315-26 CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission announced today it has filed a lawsuit against Utah to block the state’s efforts to shut down CFTC-registered contract markets using state laws. The lawsuit follows Utah’s decision to file civil enforcement actions in state court against CFTC-regulated markets and other businesses. Utah’s effort to restrict the functioning of CFTC-registered exchanges obstructs Congress’s decision to federally preempt state law. “Utah seeks to shut down prediction markets across a wide variety of markets,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Event contracts do not just serve hedging and investment purposes—they also provide the public with information about the outcome of future events. Congress entrusted the CFTC to be the federal regulator with sole responsibility to oversee these markets. As I’ve said before, the CFTC has the expertise and responsibility to defend its exclusive jurisdiction over commodity derivatives, and that’s exactly what we’ll do.” This action reflects the CFTC’s firm commitment to maintaining its exclusive jurisdiction over CFTC-registered prediction markets. The CFTC continues to draw a clear line: if a state challenges the lawful operation of a derivatives exchange, the Commission will protect federal sovereign interests. The Commission has also initiated legal proceedings against nine other states and has submitted briefs in four federal courts of appeal and one state supreme court. -CFTC-
